dubai/ib-myp-biology-home-tutor.programmesIntro: Cost tracks the stage, not just the subject. A PYP science session and a Diploma Biology internal assessment block are priced differently everywhere in the Dubai market, and knowing why helps a family judge whether a quote is reasonable for the year their child is in.

programmes.name: Primary Years Programme
programmes.description: Science arrives inside transdisciplinary units rather than as a named subject, and there is no criterion marking. Support at this stage is usually about reading, writing and confidence rather than scientific content, which is why it sits at the lower end of every published rate card in the city. Sessions tend to be shorter, 30 to 45 minutes, and the market prices accordingly.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai families often start looking in Year 5 or 6, when the move to MYP Year 1 is visible. Paying specialist science rates at this point is rarely necessary. What is worth paying for is a tutor who will build the habit of writing what happened and whether the answer was convincing, because that habit is what MYP criterion B later formalises and marks.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Five years, four criteria per subject group, each marked out of eight. Sciences is usually integrated, with Biology inside it. Rates rise through the programme: MYP Years 1 to 3 generally price like general secondary support, while Years 4 and 5 attract specialist rates because the assessment load, the investigation write-ups and in some schools the on-screen eAssessment all arrive at once.
programmes.countryNote: The Dubai market price for MYP support sits noticeably below Diploma support, which makes Years 3 and 4 the most cost-efficient point to intervene. A criterion weakness fixed at Year 4 costs a fraction of what the same weakness costs when it reappears inside a Diploma internal assessment two years later, at specialist exam-year rates.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: External papers plus one independently designed internal investigation. This is where the published Dubai rates peak: specialist IB tutoring is advertised in the AED 200 to 450 band and a premium tier quotes AED 500 to 650 an hour. Internal assessment support is frequently sold as a block of hours rather than weekly sessions, which is worth checking against a per-session alternative.
programmes.countryNote: A rate survey of the Dubai market estimates monthly spend for weekly one-hour sessions at AED 1,000 to 2,000 and upward for specialist exam-year support. Across a two-year Diploma that is a real household figure, and it is the strongest financial argument for closing MYP criterion gaps early rather than paying Diploma rates to close them late.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: A career-related study combined with a smaller set of Diploma courses, a reflective project and a personal and professional skills course. Where a student keeps a Diploma science inside the CP, that course is priced like any Diploma course; the career-related components are usually supported by the school rather than by private tutors.
programmes.countryNote: Only a small number of Dubai schools offer the CP, so the private tutoring market for it is thin and quotes vary more than for the Diploma. Families should confirm what is actually being taught before accepting a rate, and check the course list directly with the school's coordinator rather than relying on a tutoring provider's description.

dubai/ib-myp-biology-home-tutor.subjectsIntro: Not every subject prices the same way in Dubai. The pattern across published rate cards is consistent: subjects with heavy marking between sessions and subjects with a thin local specialist pool cost more per hour than subjects with neither.

subjects.name: Sciences: Biology strand
subjects.description: Mid-band pricing at MYP level and specialist pricing from Year 4 upward. The cost driver is marking: an investigation report takes a tutor 30 to 45 minutes to annotate properly against four criterion strands, and a quote that includes that work will look higher per hour than one that does not.

subjects.name: Sciences: Chemistry strand
subjects.description: Prices similarly to Biology in Dubai, with a slightly thinner MYP-specialist pool because many chemistry tutors in the market are oriented to IGCSE and A Level. Families often find the quoted rate rises faster between MYP Year 3 and Year 5 than it does for Biology.

subjects.name: Sciences: Physics strand
subjects.description: The thinnest specialist pool of the three strands at MYP level, and the one where in-home searching most often fails outright in a given community. Where a single Sciences grade is being reported, families sometimes pay for Biology support when the marks were actually lost in Physics.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.description: The most competitive subject in the Dubai market and consequently the cheapest per hour at MYP level. It is also the subject most often bundled with Sciences, because criterion C data handling in Biology is a mathematics skill and one tutor can reasonably cover both.

subjects.name: Language and Literature
subjects.description: Priced above mathematics almost everywhere, because essay marking carries real hours between sessions. Relevant to a Biology budget: students who cannot sustain an argued paragraph lose criterion D marks in Sciences, and fixing that once benefits both subjects.

subjects.name: Language Acquisition
subjects.description: Phase-dependent pricing, with higher phases nearer subject-specialist rates. For a Biology budget the point is targeted vocabulary work: a small number of sessions on technical word pairs often lifts a criterion A mark more cheaply than additional content teaching.

subjects.name: Individuals and Societies
subjects.description: Mid-band pricing with the same marking overhead as other written subjects. Criterion D in Sciences asks for balanced discussion of applications of science, which is a humanities skill, so students already supported here rarely need extra hours for it.

subjects.name: Design
subjects.description: A thin specialist pool in the Dubai private market and variable quotes as a result. The MYP Design cycle maps closely onto Sciences criteria B and C, so a student secure in one often needs fewer paid hours in the other.

subjects.name: Personal Project
subjects.description: Frequently sold as a block of supervision hours rather than weekly sessions. Worth scrutinising carefully: legitimate support is process coaching, planning and reflection, and any arrangement that implies the product will be produced for the student is both a waste of money and an academic-honesty risk.

subjects.name: Interdisciplinary units
subjects.description: Rarely priced separately, but worth raising when agreeing a rate, because an interdisciplinary task pairing Sciences with another subject group may need a tutor comfortable in both. Paying two tutors for one task is a common and avoidable cost.

dubai/ib-myp-biology-home-tutor.regionsIntro: On an in-home arrangement, your community decides your price. The distance between a tutor's base and your door sets the travel they have to recover, which is why the same hour quotes differently across Dubai. Online delivery removes that variable entirely, so these notes describe the market rather than our rates.

regions.name: Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence
regions.note: Dense, central and well supplied with tutors, so in-home quotes here tend to sit mid-band rather than high. The cost is in parking and building access rather than in distance, and evening sessions are commonly quoted as 90 minutes because a 60-minute visit is uneconomic for the tutor.

regions.name: Arabian Ranches and Dubai Hills Estate
regions.note: Villa communities where internal distances are significant and the drive from central Dubai at 16:30 is unpredictable. In-home rates here sit at the upper end of the published band, and two-hour sittings are the norm because the travel cannot be recovered across a single hour.

regions.name: Mirdif and Al Warqa
regions.note: A long cross-city drive from the main tutor concentrations in New Dubai, which shows directly in quoted rates. Families here report the widest spread between the first and the fifth quote they collect, which usually reflects where each tutor happens to live rather than what they teach.

regions.name: Jumeirah Village Circle and Dubai Sports City
regions.note: Growing fast, with newer schools and a thinner local specialist pool. The practical result is that an MYP Sciences specialist is often simply not available in-home at any rate, and families either accept a generalist or move to online delivery.

regions.name: Al Barsha and Al Barsha South
regions.note: Central to several international schools and therefore well supplied, with competitive in-home pricing at the lower end of the band. The constraint here is timing rather than cost: the same popular 17:00 slot is being chased by a large number of households in a small area.

regions.name: Jumeirah and Umm Suqeim
regions.note: Short school runs and early availability, which supports 16:00 starts and therefore shorter, cheaper sittings. Quotes here cluster tightly, and families comparing three providers often find less than AED 50 an hour between them for the same brief.

regions.name: Business Bay and Downtown Dubai
regions.note: High-rise living with limited quiet study space, so some of what an in-home visit is buying is simply a room. Rates are mid-band, but families frequently pay for a two-hour visit and lose part of it to interruptions that an online session scheduled at 20:00 avoids.

regions.name: Dubai Silicon Oasis and Academic City
regions.note: Close to several campuses, which widens the supply of student tutors at entry-level rates. That makes the bottom of the market genuinely cheap here, and makes it more important to establish whether a tutor has actually taught the MYP criteria before rather than only studied the subject.

regions.name: Emirates Hills, Meadows and Springs
regions.note: Established IB catchment with experienced in-home tutors and quotes at the top of the published range. Families here are often paying specialist rates already, and the useful question becomes whether the specialism is MYP criterion marking or simply long experience of science teaching.

schoolClusters.city: Dubai IB schools where MYP Sciences is reported as one grade
schoolClusters.note: Fee bands at these schools differ widely, and KHDA confirmed in May 2026 that private school fees in the emirate would not rise for 2026-27 under Dubai's second economic incentives package. That freeze is the right backdrop for any tutoring budget conversation this year.

schoolClusters.city: Dubai IB schools that separate the sciences before Year 5
schoolClusters.note: Where Biology, Chemistry and Physics are reported separately from MYP Year 4, families can see which strand to spend on. Where a single Sciences grade is reported, the diagnostic step comes first, and paying for the wrong strand is the most common avoidable cost in this market.

sections.heading: What the Dubai market charges, by provider model
paragraphs: The published rates for private tutoring in Dubai separate into five reasonably stable tiers, and they separate by who is teaching rather than by what is being taught. At the bottom are platforms using university students and non-specialist graduates, advertising entry rates from roughly AED 33 to 65 an hour online. Above that sits the qualified subject teacher working online, generally AED 150 to 300. In-home one-to-one occupies AED 180 to 500 depending on the tutor and the distance. IB, IGCSE and A Level specialists are advertised at AED 200 to 450 and above. A small premium tier quotes AED 500 to 650 for named or examiner-experienced tutors.

These are market figures compiled in October 2026 from UAE provider pages and from a published Dubai tutoring rate survey. They are not IB Gram's prices, and no honest page should present a market band as its own rate card. What they are useful for is calibration. A quote of AED 90 an hour for MYP Sciences is not a bargain specialist; it is almost certainly a non-specialist, and for criterion-marked work that distinction decides whether the hour achieves anything. A quote of AED 600 is not necessarily wrong either, but it should come with something specific attached that explains it.

The honest caution attached to the premium tier is worth stating. Examiner status is frequently advertised and rarely evidenced, and no tutor's examiner experience gives anyone access to marking decisions, grade boundaries or unreleased paper content. If a provider's price rests on that claim, ask what exactly is being claimed and for which board and year. A page that quotes a rate and declines to say what it buys is the pattern this market is full of, which is precisely why the table below separates the model from the number.

sections.heading: Why an in-home hour prices above the same hour online
paragraphs: The difference between the in-home band and the online band is not teaching quality. It is time nobody is teaching. A tutor booked for 17:00 in a villa community twenty-five minutes from their own home, in Dubai traffic, at the end of the school run, is realistically committing two to two and a half hours. They can take one such booking that evening, perhaps two if the second is in the same community. An online tutor can take three consecutive sessions in the same window and still have the evening. The rate reflects the arithmetic.

That has a knock-on effect families notice too late: the in-home market pushes towards long sittings. If the travel is fixed, the only way to make it efficient is to stay longer, which is why monthly in-home packages in Dubai commonly appear as four two-hour visits at AED 1,599 to 1,799, against roughly AED 799 for eight online sessions. For a Diploma student working through an extended investigation, two hours can be productive. For a thirteen-year-old rewriting one method statement until the variables are properly controlled, the second hour is usually spent on diminishing returns.

The third effect is the one that actually matters for a criterion-marked programme. Geography is a selection filter, and it is the wrong one. Within a short drive of a given Dubai community there may be several capable science tutors and very few who have taught MYP Sciences, can read criterion descriptors, and know why criterion C evaluations fail. Online delivery replaces the map with a subject list. A family in Jumeirah Village Circle gets the same shortlist as one in Emirates Hills, which is not true of any in-home arrangement in the city at any price.

So the position on this page is plain. IB Gram does not offer home visits in Dubai or anywhere else in the UAE; that service exists only in India. We are not pretending the in-home market has no advantages, and for some families and some subjects it does. For MYP Biology specifically, where the marks turn on investigation design, data handling and written evaluation, a screen-shared document and a specialist is a better hour than a generalist in the room.

sections.heading: The monthly and yearly arithmetic for an MYP Biology plan
paragraphs: Hourly rates are the wrong unit for a household budget. What a family actually commits to is a pattern across a term or a year, and the published Dubai estimates for weekly one-hour sessions run from roughly AED 240 to 600 a month at the budget end, AED 600 to 1,200 in the mid range, and AED 1,000 to 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year support. Those figures assume four or five sessions a month and no marking charged separately.

For MYP Biology the pattern that works is usually modest: one session a week through a term, with one small written task marked in between. That is around 12 to 14 sessions a term and 36 to 40 across an academic year, allowing for school holidays. At a mid-band specialist rate that is a real but predictable number, and it compares favourably with the intensive blocks families often buy in a panic in Year 5 or in the first Diploma term, which arrive at specialist exam-season rates and compress the same learning into fewer, more expensive weeks.

The cheapest version of this plan is the early one. A criterion B weakness in MYP Year 3 takes a handful of sessions at MYP rates. The same weakness, unaddressed, reappears as a struggling Diploma internal assessment in Year 12, where the published Dubai specialist band is AED 200 to 450 an hour and the work is urgent. Families who treat MYP Years 3 and 4 as the intervention window rather than the waiting room spend materially less over six years, which is the only honest financial argument for starting now rather than later.

One structural point about how to pay. A package bought up front is only a saving if every session in it is used, and MYP families lose sessions to school trips, exam weeks, travel and illness more often than they expect. Per-session payment with an agreed rate removes that risk. If a provider offers a discount for a block, the question to ask is what happens to unused sessions and whether the rate still applies if you pause for six weeks.

sections.heading: What moves the number in Dubai specifically
paragraphs: Five local factors push a Dubai tutoring quote up or down, and none of them is the subject. The first is distance, which applies only to in-home arrangements and can be the largest single component of the rate. A tutor based in Deira quoting for a villa in Dubai Hills is pricing an hour of driving into every lesson, and the honest ones say so. Online delivery removes this entirely, which is why the same tutor's online rate is often meaningfully lower than their in-home rate for identical teaching.

The second is the time slot. Every household in a Dubai community wants 17:00, after the school run and before dinner. That slot is scarce, and scarcity shows up in price and in availability. Families willing to take 19:30 or a Saturday morning consistently report both better rates and better tutors, because they are choosing from the part of the week that is not oversubscribed. For an MYP student, a later slot is often better teaching anyway, once the day has finished rather than in the gap between activities.

The third is the season. Demand concentrates in the weeks before major assessments and before the May examination period that UAE schools sit, and rates firm up accordingly. The fourth is Ramadan, which reshapes the school day and moves sessions to post-Iftar timing; providers who cannot flex to that effectively lose a month, and some price the inconvenience. The fifth is school fee context: KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that private school fees in Dubai would not rise for 2026-27, under Dubai's second economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion. With fees held flat, the tutoring line in a household budget has become more visible rather than less.

A sixth factor is supply, and it is the one families discover last. Dubai's 2026-27 intake adds seven new private schools, three of them International Baccalaureate, creating 16,846 places, after enrolment rose six per cent during 2025-26. More IB students means more competition for the same MYP specialist hours. That pressure is felt most acutely by families buying in-home, because their pool is bounded by a map, and least by families buying online, whose pool is bounded by subject.

sections.heading: The MoHRE permit: free to hold, worth asking about
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by permit. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is administered by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation. Official UAE government guidance states the permit is granted free of charge for two years, and that eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18, and university students. MoHRE's own service page lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time, applied for through its app, website and e-services system.

Two things follow for a Dubai family comparing quotes. First, no part of a legitimate rate is the cost of the permit, because there is no cost. Any provider explaining a premium by reference to licensing fees is describing something that does not exist. Second, the permit is a reasonable thing to ask about, and a tutor who holds one can say so plainly. Official guidance also states that individuals offering private tutoring without a permit from MoHRE are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule has been published, so no figure should be quoted by anyone, including us.

There is a related boundary that affects who you should be hiring. In Abu Dhabi, ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff have been reported as prohibiting teachers from giving paid private tuition to students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit's code of conduct has been reported as barring the same arrangement. Families sometimes ask whether their child's own class teacher can tutor them privately. The arrangement is one to avoid, and any provider marketing it is pointing you somewhere you should not go.

Finally, a distinction worth knowing because it is routinely blurred in this market. An individual tutor holding a MoHRE permit is a different legal entity from a tutoring operation with premises and staff in Dubai, which requires a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute. IB Gram holds no KHDA permit, no ADEK approval and no regulator accreditation of any kind, and has no office, centre or branch in the UAE. We describe what the regulators do because it is useful; we do not claim their endorsement, and neither should anyone quoting you a rate.

sections.heading: Reading a Dubai tutoring quote line by line
paragraphs: Two quotes for MYP Biology can differ by AED 150 an hour and describe entirely different products, which is why comparing headline rates alone is close to useless. Six questions turn a number into something comparable. Is the rate per 60 minutes or per lesson, and how long is a lesson? Many Dubai providers quote per session and run 45 or 50 minutes, which changes the effective hourly figure materially.

Second: does the rate include marking between sessions? For MYP Sciences this is the single biggest hidden variable. Annotating an investigation report against four criterion strands takes a tutor 30 to 45 minutes. A rate that includes it is not comparable to one that does not, and for criterion-marked work the marking is where much of the value sits. Third: what happens if you cancel, and how much notice is required? Fourth: is value-added tax included in the figure quoted? Do not accept a general statement about how tuition is treated for tax; ask only whether the specific number you have been given is the number you will pay.

Fifth: who exactly will teach the lesson? A quote from an agency is a quote for an unnamed tutor unless you ask. For MYP Sciences the relevant question is not whether they have a degree in biology but whether they have taught the MYP criteria and can read a criterion sheet. Ask directly, and ask for an example of a criterion strand they would target in your child's marked work. Sixth: what happens if the match is wrong? A provider with a replacement policy will say so without hesitation.

One last line to look for, and it is usually absent: what the provider will do if nobody suitable is available. The UAE tutoring market conceals coverage limits routinely. Our answer is that if no MYP Sciences specialist with Biology as a main strand has a workable slot in Gulf Standard Time, we will say so and give a realistic date, rather than placing a generalist and describing them as a specialist. A free trial lesson, one per student with no card details taken, exists so that this judgement is yours rather than ours.

sections.heading: What an MYP Biology hour should actually buy
paragraphs: Price only means something next to what is delivered, so here is what the hour should contain for MYP Biology at any rate in the Dubai band. It should begin with the student's own marked work, read by the tutor before the lesson rather than during it. Preparation time that happens inside the paid hour is time you are paying twice for: once as teaching and once as reading.

It should name a target. MYP Sciences is marked on four criteria out of eight each, and a session that is about Biology in general is a session that cannot be evaluated. A session about criterion C, specifically the evaluation strand, specifically on the last investigation, is one you can judge by looking at the next piece of work. That is what makes the spend measurable rather than hopeful.

It should leave something behind. One small written task, set and then marked before the following session, is the mechanism that turns a sequence of hours into movement on a criterion total. Without it each lesson restarts. With it, a family accumulates a parallel record of criterion marks and can see progress months before a report card arrives, which is also how you decide whether to keep paying.

And it should end honestly. If three sessions of criterion work show that the real weakness is in mathematics, in written English, or in Physics rather than Biology, the right outcome is to say so and change the plan, even though that means fewer Biology hours sold. Support that is no longer needed should stop. A provider that cannot imagine recommending less of itself is a provider whose advice about how much you should spend is worth very little.

sections.heading: Where the money is best spent across five MYP years
paragraphs: If a family had a fixed tutoring budget to spread across MYP Years 1 to 5, the efficient allocation is not even. Years 1 and 2 rarely need paid science support at all; what helps most at that stage is reading volume and the habit of writing a full sentence, both of which happen at home for nothing. Spending here is usually spending early for reassurance rather than for effect.

Year 3 is the first genuinely high-value window. Criterion expectations step up, investigation write-ups start carrying real weight, and most students have had no explicit teaching of what criterion B wants. A small number of sessions here, four to six, spent entirely on method writing and data handling, pays for itself twice: once in the Year 3 and 4 grades, and again in the Diploma, where the same skills are examined under stricter conditions at higher rates.

Year 4 is the second window, and in many Dubai schools it is where integrated Sciences splits into separate strands and the reported grade suddenly has nowhere to hide. This is the point at which a diagnostic block is worth buying before a term of weekly sessions, because the newly separated grades tell you which strand to fund. Families who skip the diagnosis frequently spend a term on Biology when the criterion marks were falling in Physics.

Year 5 is the most expensive year to need help in, because the Personal Project, any eAssessment preparation and the Diploma subject choice all land together and the market prices urgency. Budget for it, but aim not to spend it. A student who arrives in Year 5 with secure criterion B and C skills needs supervision and structure rather than remediation, which is a cheaper product. That sequencing, modest spend early and planned restraint late, is the single most cost-effective pattern we see across Dubai MYP families.

faqs.question: What does an MYP Biology home tutor charge per hour in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Published market rates for in-home one-to-one tutoring in Dubai run from about AED 180 to 500 an hour, with a Dubai rate survey placing most in-home work at AED 180 to 350 and independent tutors advertising AED 200 to 500. For MYP Sciences specifically, expect the upper half of that range from anyone who has actually taught the criteria. Online, a qualified subject teacher sits at roughly AED 150 to 300 and an IB specialist at AED 200 to 450. Those figures were compiled in October 2026 from published provider pages and are market rates rather than IB Gram's. The gap between the in-home and online bands is travel, not teaching.

faqs.question: Why is an in-home MYP Biology visit priced above the same lesson online?
faqs.answer: Because the tutor is paid for the hour and spends two and a half. A 17:00 booking in a villa community twenty-five minutes away, in school-run traffic, consumes the whole evening for one or two lessons. Online, the same tutor can teach three consecutive sessions in that window. The rate carries the difference. It also pushes the market towards long sittings, which is why in-home monthly packages in Dubai commonly appear as four two-hour visits around AED 1,599 to 1,799, against roughly AED 799 for eight online sessions. For a thirteen-year-old rewriting one method statement, the second hour is rarely the productive one.

faqs.question: How much of a Dubai home tutor fee is really travel time?
faqs.answer: Nobody itemises it, but the arithmetic is not hard. If a tutor's online rate is AED 220 and their in-home rate for the same lesson is AED 350, the difference is the travel, the fuel and the lost booking slot. Across Dubai the spread between a tutor's own two rates is commonly AED 80 to 200 an hour depending on the distance to your community, which is why the same brief quotes differently in Mirdif and in Al Barsha. The useful test is to ask one tutor for both rates. A tutor who quotes an identical figure for both formats has either absorbed the travel or is pricing the online lesson above what it costs them to deliver.

faqs.question: What does a term of weekly MYP Biology support cost in AED?
faqs.answer: A realistic pattern is 12 to 14 sessions in a term, one a week with one small marked task in between. Published Dubai estimates for weekly one-hour sessions put monthly spend at roughly AED 240 to 600 at the budget end, AED 600 to 1,200 mid-range, and AED 1,000 to 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year work. For MYP Sciences the mid-range is the honest planning figure, which puts a term in the low thousands of dirhams at market rates. Buying per session rather than per term protects that budget, because MYP families lose more sessions to trips and assessment weeks than they expect.

faqs.question: Does the MYP Biology rate change in the run-up to on-screen examinations?
faqs.answer: In the Dubai market, yes. Demand concentrates in the weeks before major assessed tasks and before the May examination period UAE schools sit, and rates firm up with it. Specialist exam-season monthly estimates published for Dubai start around AED 1,000 and run upward. The practical consequence is that the cheapest way to buy examination-season support is not to need much of it: a criterion B or C weakness addressed in MYP Year 3 or 4 at ordinary rates costs a fraction of the same weakness addressed urgently in Year 5. Our own rate is agreed per session in advance and does not move because the calendar did.

faqs.question: Is a small group cheaper than one-to-one for MYP Biology in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Per student, yes, and tuition centres in the city price group classes well below one-to-one. Whether it is cheaper in any useful sense depends on the problem. Group teaching works when a cohort shares a content gap, for example a whole class that has not met gas exchange. It works poorly for criterion-specific weaknesses, because criterion C evaluation marks are lost in individual ways and the fix is annotation of that student's own script. Families often buy a term of group classes, see no movement in the criterion marks, and then buy one-to-one anyway, which is the most expensive route of all.

faqs.question: Do private tutors in Dubai pay for the MoHRE permit, and does that reach my bill?
faqs.answer: No, on both counts. The private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is granted free of charge and is valid for two years, and MoHRE's own service page lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time. So no part of a legitimate Dubai tutoring rate is licensing cost, and any provider explaining a premium that way is describing something that does not exist. Official guidance does state that tutoring without a permit attracts fines and penalties under the applicable laws, but no schedule of amounts is published, so no figure should be quoted by anyone.

faqs.question: How should I compare two MYP Biology quotes in AED?
faqs.answer: Convert both to the same unit, then ask what is inside it. Is the rate per 60 minutes or per lesson, and how long is a lesson, since many Dubai providers run 45 or 50 minutes. Does it include marking between sessions, which for an investigation report is 30 to 45 minutes of a tutor's time. Is the figure tax inclusive. What notice is required to cancel. Who specifically teaches it, and have they taught the MYP criteria rather than simply studied biology. What happens if the match is wrong. Two quotes AED 150 apart frequently describe different products once those six answers are in.

faqs.question: What is an MYP Biology lesson priced per 60 minutes against per 90 minutes?
faqs.answer: Longer sittings usually carry a lower effective hourly rate, which looks like value and often is not at MYP age. A 90-minute session is priced at roughly one and a half times the hourly figure, sometimes slightly less. The question is whether the second half is productive. For an eleven to fourteen-year-old working on one criterion strand, attention typically holds for 50 to 60 minutes of active rewriting. The in-home market favours 90 or 120 minutes because the travel has to be recovered. Online, there is no reason to buy length you cannot use, and two shorter sessions in a week outperform one long one in most MYP cases.

faqs.question: Does the quoted AED figure include marking between MYP Biology sessions?
faqs.answer: Ask, because it is the largest hidden variable in this market. Annotating a laboratory investigation properly against four criterion strands takes a tutor 30 to 45 minutes, and a rate that includes that work is simply not comparable to one that does not. For criterion-marked programmes much of the value sits in the annotation rather than in the live hour, because that is where the student sees exactly which strand they missed. Our rates state explicitly whether marking is included before you book, and the task set between sessions is deliberately small so that it comes back and gets marked rather than becoming homework nobody completes.

faqs.question: How does MYP Biology tutoring sit next to Dubai school fees?
faqs.answer: It has become more visible this year, because KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that private school fees in Dubai would not rise for 2026-27, under Dubai's second economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion. With fees flat, a tutoring line is one of the few education costs in a Dubai household that still moves. Set against annual fees at an IB school, a weekly MYP session at mid-band market rates is a modest addition, but it is a recurring one. That is the argument for scoping support to a named criterion with a review date rather than running it indefinitely because it feels responsible.

faqs.question: What hidden extras appear on a Dubai tutoring invoice?
faqs.answer: Five recur. Registration or matching fees charged before any teaching happens. Materials or platform charges added monthly. Marking billed separately from the lesson. Cancellation charges with a notice period longer than families expect, sometimes 48 hours. And rate escalation on renewal, where an introductory figure rises once a term is underway. None of these is improper if disclosed up front, and all of them are reasons to get the full structure in writing before the first session rather than only the headline rate. Ask specifically what you would be charged in a month when your child attends three sessions instead of four.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to start MYP Biology support in Year 3 or wait for Year 5?
faqs.answer: Materially cheaper to start in Year 3, and this is the clearest financial pattern in the Dubai MYP market. At Year 3 the work is four to six sessions teaching what criterion B actually wants, at ordinary MYP rates, before bad habits set. Left alone, the same weakness reappears in Year 5 alongside the Personal Project and Diploma subject choice, when the market prices urgency, and again in Year 12 inside a Diploma internal assessment where published Dubai specialist rates run AED 200 to 450 an hour. Spending early and planning not to spend late is the efficient sequence, not the cautious one.

faqs.question: Can we pay for MYP Biology sessions one at a time rather than a package?
faqs.answer: Yes, and for MYP families it is usually the better structure. Sessions are agreed and paid individually, with the rate fixed in advance, so a half-term disrupted by a school trip, an assessment week or family travel costs nothing. There is no expiring credit and no rollover to track. Packages are only a saving if every session is used, and in practice MYP schedules are interrupted more often than Diploma ones. If a provider offers a block discount, ask what happens to unused sessions and whether the agreed rate survives a six-week pause before deciding it is cheaper.

faqs.question: What happens to the price if no Dubai-based MYP Biology specialist is free?
faqs.answer: Nothing happens to the price, because we do not fill the gap with a different product and charge you for it. If no MYP Sciences specialist with Biology as a main strand has a workable slot in Gulf Standard Time, we say so and give a realistic date rather than placing a generalist and calling the match a specialist one. Where a suitable tutor is based outside the UAE, that is stated plainly along with the time zone the sessions would run in. The UAE tutoring market routinely conceals coverage limits behind an overseas contact number, and disclosure costs nothing to give.

faqs.question: Does a free trial lesson mean the first MYP Biology session costs nothing?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the conditions stated here rather than in a footnote. One free trial lesson per student, taught by the tutor who would continue, with no card details taken and no obligation to book anything afterwards. It is a full working session: the tutor reads your child's marked work beforehand, teaches one criterion strand, and sets a small task. If the match is wrong, say so and a different tutor is proposed at no charge. Nothing is invoiced until you agree a rate and a session in writing, and the rate quoted is the rate charged.

intro.heading: What changes when Biology is marked by criteria
paragraphs: Parents searching for an IB MYP Biology tutor in Dubai almost always arrive with the same piece of paper: a report card showing a number between 1 and 7, with no explanation of how that number was reached. The number is not a percentage and it is not an average of test scores. It is the product of a 32-mark criterion total, built from four separate judgements a teacher makes about four different kinds of thinking. Until a family can see which of those four judgements is pulling the grade down, extra Biology revision is guesswork.

The four criteria in MYP Sciences are fixed. Criterion A is knowing and understanding, criterion B is inquiring and designing, criterion C is processing and evaluating, and criterion D is reflecting on the impacts of science. Each is marked on a 0 to 8 scale against published descriptors, and each has its own strands that a teacher ticks off task by task. A student who can name every organelle in a plant cell but cannot write a hypothesis with a measurable independent variable will sit at 7 on A and 3 on B, and the report will say 5 without telling you why.

This matters more in Biology than in the other science strands, because Biology in the MYP carries a heavy load of extended written response. The content itself feels accessible: digestion, transport systems, reproduction, ecosystems, genetics, classification. Students read it, recognise it, and assume they know it. Then an assessment asks them to design a fair test of the effect of light intensity on the rate of photosynthesis, control three variables, justify a sample size, and evaluate the reliability of their own data. The Biology knowledge is not the obstacle. The scientific method written in formal language is.

Dubai adds a second layer. Many MYP cohorts in the city are built from students who arrived mid-programme from a British, Indian or American system, where science was taught as content with end-of-topic tests. A child who moved into MYP Year 3 from a CBSE school has often never designed an investigation, never written a method in the passive voice, and never been asked what the social implications of gene editing might be. The content gap is small; the assessment-literacy gap is large, and it is invisible on a report card.

What a session does, therefore, is narrow. The tutor asks for the last two or three marked Biology tasks with the criterion sheets attached, reads the teacher's annotations, and identifies which criterion is costing marks and which strand inside it. Then the work is specific: rewriting one method until the variables are properly controlled, re-plotting one graph with correct axes and units, redrafting one evaluation paragraph until it names a source of error and explains its direction. Biology content gets taught where it is genuinely missing. The rest of the time goes on the skills the criteria actually reward.

Everything is delivered one-to-one over live video. IB Gram does not run in-home tutoring anywhere in the UAE, and that is a deliberate choice rather than a limitation: a Dubai family gets a tutor who has taught MYP Sciences and marked to criterion descriptors, instead of whoever is available within a reasonable drive of their community.

dubai/ib-myp-biology-tutor.programmesIntro: MYP Biology does not stand alone. It sits between the inquiry habits built in the PYP and the assessment machinery of the Diploma Programme, and a tutor who knows what comes next teaches the current year differently. Here is how each programme treats science, and what each means for a family in Dubai.

programmes.name: Primary Years Programme
programmes.description: Science in the PYP arrives through transdisciplinary units rather than named subjects. Children investigate living things, habitats and life cycles inside themes such as how the world works and sharing the planet. There is no criterion marking and no formal science grade. What the PYP does build is the habit of asking a question, recording what happened and saying whether the answer was convincing, which is the raw material criterion B later formalises.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai PYP cohorts feed into MYP Year 1 at a wide range of schools, and the handover is where the first science gap appears. A child who spent Year 6 on inquiry projects with no written method can find the MYP's formal laboratory report alien in the first term. Families who ask for support at this point usually need writing structure rather than Biology content.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: The MYP runs five years and assesses every subject group against four criteria scored 0-8. In Sciences, Biology is usually taught inside an integrated course alongside Chemistry and Physics, with units framed by key concepts, related concepts and global contexts. Year 5 adds the Personal Project and, in schools that register for it, on-screen eAssessment leading to the IB MYP Certificate. The grade on a report is a conversion of the criterion total, not a test average.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai MYP schools differ sharply in how they split the sciences. Some run fully integrated Sciences to the end of Year 5; others separate Biology, Chemistry and Physics from Year 4 to ease the move into the Diploma. A tutor needs to know which model your child's school uses before the first session, because the unit titles, the assessment calendar and the criterion weighting all follow from it.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: The Diploma Programme replaces criterion marking with external examination papers plus an internally assessed scientific investigation. Biology is offered at Standard and Higher Level, with the same core and additional higher level material. Command terms tighten, data analysis becomes quantitative, and the internal assessment is a single independent investigation judged on personal engagement, exploration, analysis, evaluation and communication rather than on four reusable criteria.
programmes.countryNote: Most Dubai MYP students who continue in the IB take Biology at either level in the Diploma, and the ones who find the jump manageable are those whose MYP criterion B and C marks were already strong. Diploma teachers in Dubai report the same recurring weakness at the start of Year 12: students who can recall biology but cannot write an evaluation that distinguishes random error from systematic bias.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: The Career-related Programme pairs a career-related study with a small number of Diploma courses, a reflective project and a personal and professional skills course. Students who want applied science alongside a vocational pathway, in health sciences or sports science for example, can keep a Diploma Biology course inside a CP framework rather than carrying a full Diploma load.
programmes.countryNote: The CP is offered by a small number of Dubai schools and is often overlooked by families comparing options after MYP Year 5. For a student whose MYP Biology marks are sound but whose overall profile is uneven, it can be a better fit than a full Diploma. Any school's CP course list should be checked directly with its coordinator before plans are made.

dubai/ib-myp-biology-tutor.subjectsIntro: A Biology problem in the MYP is frequently a writing problem, a mathematics problem or a research problem wearing a lab coat. These are the subject groups a Dubai MYP student is carrying at the same time, and the ones most likely to be implicated when Biology marks slide.

subjects.name: Sciences: Biology strand
subjects.description: Cells, transport systems, nutrition and digestion, respiration and gas exchange, reproduction, inheritance and variation, ecosystems and human impact. Marks are lost less on recall than on explaining a mechanism in sequence: students name the structures and skip the causal chain that links structure to function.

subjects.name: Sciences: integrated course
subjects.levels: MYP Years 1-5, where schools do not separate the strands
subjects.description: Many Dubai schools assess a single Sciences grade covering Biology, Chemistry and Physics. One weak strand drags the whole criterion total down, and a report showing 4 in Sciences can conceal a 6 in Biology sitting next to a 2 in Physics. Unpicking that is the first job of a diagnostic session.

subjects.name: Scientific investigation skills
subjects.levels: Criteria B and C, MYP Years 1-5
subjects.description: Hypothesis writing, variable control, sample size and repeats, table design, choice of graph, calculation of means, identification of anomalies, and evaluation of method. This is a transferable skill set assessed in every science unit, and it is where most of a Dubai MYP student's recoverable marks sit.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.description: Rates, percentage change, ratio, scale, averages and graph interpretation all appear inside MYP Biology tasks. A student who cannot calculate a rate from a gradient will lose criterion C marks in a photosynthesis unit even with perfect biological understanding, which is why the two subjects are often supported together.

subjects.name: Language and Literature
subjects.description: Extended science responses are assessed partly on organisation and clarity. Students who write in fragments, or who cannot sustain a paragraph that states a claim and then supports it, carry that weakness straight into criterion D reflections on the social implications of biological science.

subjects.name: Individuals and Societies
subjects.description: Criterion D asks students to discuss the impacts of science on people and the environment. That is an Individuals and Societies skill: weighing competing interests, using evidence, acknowledging a counter-argument. Students strong in humanities often pick up these marks quickly once they are told the marks exist.

subjects.name: Design
subjects.description: The MYP Design cycle, inquiring and analysing through to evaluating, mirrors the structure of criterion B and C in Sciences. A student who has internalised the Design cycle already has the scaffolding for a laboratory investigation and simply needs the scientific vocabulary mapped onto it.

subjects.name: Language Acquisition
subjects.description: Dubai MYP cohorts include many students working in English as an additional language. Biology carries dense technical vocabulary with near-identical word pairs, mitosis and meiosis, artery and arteriole, and phase-appropriate vocabulary work often lifts a Sciences criterion A mark faster than more content teaching.

subjects.name: Interdisciplinary units
subjects.description: Schools assess at least one interdisciplinary unit per year against its own criteria. Biology is a common partner, paired with Individuals and Societies on public health or with Design on sustainable packaging. Students often treat these as a bonus task and lose marks because they do not synthesise the two disciplines explicitly.

subjects.name: Personal Project
subjects.description: The Year 5 Personal Project runs alongside subject courses and competes for the same hours. Biology-themed projects on nutrition, disease or conservation are popular. A tutor's role here is process coaching on planning, sourcing and reflection; the product and the written report must be the student's own work throughout.

dubai/ib-myp-biology-tutor.regionsIntro: Lessons are delivered over live video, so a tutor is not chosen by how close they live to you. The community still matters, because it determines which schools your child's cohort comes from, which MYP science model they follow, and what time a session can realistically start.

regions.name: Emirates Hills and Meadows
regions.note: Feeds some of Dubai's longest-running MYP cohorts, where students have been inside criterion marking since Year 1. Problems here tend to be narrow and specific, a single criterion strand rather than a general science weakness, so diagnostic sessions are short and the work is targeted.

regions.name: Al Barsha and Al Barsha South
regions.note: A dense cluster of international schools running both MYP and British pathways. Families frequently have one child in MYP Sciences and a sibling doing IGCSE Biology, and the two need entirely different teaching: criterion descriptors on one side, past papers and mark schemes on the other.

regions.name: Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence

sections.heading: The four MYP Sciences criteria, and what each one costs
paragraphs: An MYP Biology grade is assembled from four separate marks out of eight. Criterion A, knowing and understanding, asks the student to recall and apply scientific knowledge and to analyse information to make scientifically supported judgements. Criterion B, inquiring and designing, asks them to explain a problem, formulate a testable hypothesis using scientific reasoning, explain how to manipulate variables and how enough relevant data will be collected, design a logical method, and work safely. Criterion C, processing and evaluating, covers presenting data, interpreting it, drawing a conclusion supported by scientific reasoning, evaluating the validity of hypothesis and method against the outcome, and suggesting improvements. Criterion D, reflecting on the impacts of science, asks them to explain the ways science is applied to address a specific problem, discuss the implications of using science to solve it, and apply scientific language and documentation conventions correctly.

Read that list and the diagnosis writes itself. Only criterion A rewards knowing biology. The other three reward thinking like an experimenter and writing like one. A Dubai student who revises by rereading notes and memorising diagrams is preparing for a quarter of the available marks and leaving the rest to chance. That is the single most common pattern in the marked work families send through, and it is why a session that simply covers more content rarely moves the grade.

The practical consequence is that a first session should not begin with biology at all. It begins with the criterion sheets from the last two or three assessed tasks, laid next to each other. A pattern appears within minutes: strong A marks and 3s on B, or a solid B with a C mark that collapses at the evaluation strand. That pattern, not the subject, determines what the next six weeks look like. Published descriptors for each criterion sit in the MYP Sciences subject guide held by every school's MYP coordinator, and a parent is entitled to ask for them.
bullets: Criterion A rewards biological knowledge; criteria B, C and D reward scientific method and writing
Each criterion is marked 0-8 against published strands, task by task
Two or three marked tasks are enough to see which strand is costing the grade

sections.heading: From 32 marks to a number on a report card
paragraphs: The conversion step is where most parent confusion lives. At the end of a reporting period, a teacher takes the best-fit mark for each of the four criteria, adds them to give a total out of 32, and reads that total against the MYP's published grade-boundary table to produce a grade from 1 to 7. The grade is therefore a band, not a score. Two students on 5 can be four marks apart, and a student can gain three marks across the year and see no change on the report at all.

This has three practical consequences for a family planning support. The first is that the useful question to ask a teacher is not what grade my child is on but which criteria are carrying the lowest marks. The second is that progress should be tracked at criterion level, because that is where improvement appears first. The third is that the distance to the next grade is often much smaller than a parent assumes: a student sitting at the bottom of band 4 needs one criterion to move from 3 to 6, which is one term of focused work on a single skill, not a wholesale rebuild of their biology.

The boundary table below is the standard conversion schools apply to the 32-mark total. Individual schools report at different points in the year and may use interim boundaries for internal assessments, so your child's MYP coordinator should confirm which version is in use for their cohort before you read too much into a single report. What does not vary is the structure: four criteria, eight marks each, one total, one band.

sections.heading: Biology inside integrated Sciences: what Dubai schools actually teach
paragraphs: Very few Dubai MYP schools timetable a subject called Biology in the early years. The MYP Sciences subject group is normally delivered as one integrated course, with units built around key concepts such as change, relationships and systems, and related concepts such as balance, consequences, function, interaction and transformation. A unit might be called Balance in the Body or Consequences of Consumption, and a parent looking for the word Biology on a report will not find it. The biology is inside the units, distributed across the year.

A second variation matters even more. Some Dubai schools keep Sciences integrated and report a single grade through to the end of MYP Year 5. Others split the strands at Year 4, reporting separate Biology, Chemistry and Physics grades to smooth the transition into Diploma sciences. The two models produce very different reports and very different tutoring needs. Under the integrated model, a 4 in Sciences could be hiding a strong Biology performance next to a weak Physics one, and the first job is to separate them. Under the split model the diagnosis is already done, but the Year 4 jump in expectation is steeper because each strand now carries its own full criterion set.

There is a third possibility worth checking: schools that register for MYP eAssessment put Year 5 students through externally set on-screen examinations and moderated ePortfolios, leading to the IB MYP Certificate. Those schools run the final year to an external timetable with internal deadlines months ahead of it. Schools that do not register assess Year 5 entirely internally. Whether your child's school registers changes the shape of Year 5 completely, and it is the single most useful thing to establish before planning support for a Year 5 Biology student.

None of this is on a school website in enough detail to plan from. The reliable route is a direct question to the MYP coordinator: is Sciences integrated or split, at which year does it split, do you register for eAssessment, and may I see the criterion descriptors for Sciences. Four questions, one email, and the answers shape everything a tutor does.
bullets: Unit titles follow key and related concepts, so the word Biology may not appear

Schools that split the sciences usually do so at MYP Year 4

sections.heading: The investigation write-up that decides criteria B and C
paragraphs: If one document decides an MYP Biology grade, it is the laboratory investigation report. Criterion B is awarded almost entirely on its opening pages and criterion C almost entirely on its closing ones, which means roughly half the available marks on a 32-mark total hang on a piece of writing most students treat as paperwork. The highest-value hour a Dubai MYP Biology student can spend is on the structure of that document.

The failures are consistent enough to list. Research questions are written as topics rather than questions, so there is nothing measurable to test: how does light affect plants, instead of how does the distance of a lamp from a pondweed sample affect the number of oxygen bubbles released per minute. Hypotheses state a direction without a reason, when criterion B explicitly wants scientific reasoning behind the prediction. Variables are listed in three columns and then not actually controlled in the method. Sample size and repeats are chosen silently, when a sentence explaining why five repeats rather than two is worth a mark on its own.

At the other end, criterion C losses are even more predictable. Graphs appear without units on the axes, or with a line of best fit forced through points that do not support one. Conclusions restate the data instead of explaining it with biology: the rate increased, rather than the rate increased because more light energy was available to drive the light-dependent reactions. Evaluations name human error, which is not a source of error, and stop there, when the mark is for identifying a specific weakness, explaining how it affected the result, and proposing a realistic improvement.

A tutor's work here is narrow and repetitive, which is why it is effective. One investigation, redrafted properly, teaches the template for every investigation that follows. The student brings their own data and their own draft; the tutor marks it against the criterion strands, explains each loss, and the student rewrites. Nobody writes the report for them, and no tutor should ever offer to: under IB academic honesty rules the work must be the student's own, and a report that is not is a malpractice risk for the student rather than a shortcut.
bullets: Criterion B is won or lost in the research question, hypothesis and method
Criterion C is won or lost in the graph, the conclusion and the evaluation
Human error is not a source of error and earns nothing
The student writes every draft; a tutor marks, explains and sets the rewrite

sections.heading: Command terms: the two words that decide the mark
paragraphs: MYP assessment tasks are built on command terms, and each term has a defined meaning published in the subject guide. State, outline, describe, explain, analyse, evaluate, discuss and justify ask for measurably different things. A student who answers every question with everything they know about the topic will score well on the few questions that happen to want that and poorly on the rest, and the pattern on their criterion sheets will look random when it is in fact entirely systematic.

In Biology the gap between describe and explain costs more marks than any other single confusion. Describe asks for an account of what happens; explain asks for the reasons why, the mechanism, the causal chain. A student describing gas exchange will list the alveoli, the capillaries and the thin walls. A student explaining it will say that the thin walls shorten the diffusion pathway, that the dense capillary network maintains a steep concentration gradient, and that ventilation refreshes the air in the alveoli to keep that gradient steep. Same knowledge, different answer, several marks apart.

Analyse and evaluate carry the same trap at the top of the mark range. Analyse asks the student to break material into parts and show relationships; evaluate asks for a judgement supported by evidence, with limitations acknowledged. In criterion D tasks on applications of biological science, a one-sided answer can be perfectly accurate and still sit at 3 or 4, because the descriptor wants implications discussed rather than benefits listed. Teaching the term, then re-answering a question the student has already attempted, is one of the fastest mark gains available in MYP Sciences.

The table below lists the terms that recur most in MYP Biology tasks and the answer pattern each one wants. It is worth printing and keeping next to the student while they work, at least until the distinctions become automatic.
