sections.heading: What a Dubai MYP Biology session looks like, minute by minute
paragraphs: A 60-minute online session that works has a shape, and it is not a lecture. The first five minutes are spent on the marked work that arrived before the lesson, with the tutor naming the criterion and strand being targeted today. Saying it out loud matters: students who know they are working on criterion C evaluation rather than on photosynthesis in general behave differently for the next fifty minutes.

The middle forty minutes are student-active. The tutor shares the student's own script on screen and works through the loss points, but the student does the writing. A typical sequence is read the descriptor, read your answer, tell me which strand you have not met, now rewrite the sentence. A screen-shared document means both parties see the same text and the rewrite happens live rather than being promised as homework. Where a genuine content gap appears, the tutor teaches it there and then, briefly, and returns to the task.

The final ten minutes set and explain the between-session task. It is deliberately small: one paragraph, one method, one graph re-plotted. Small tasks come back. Large ones do not, and a task that does not come back wastes the following session. The tutor marks what returns against the same criterion strands the school uses, so the family accumulates a parallel record of criterion marks rather than waiting for a report card three months away.

Everything happens over live video, screen-sharing the student's own documents, with sessions scheduled in Gulf Standard Time around the Dubai school day. There are no home visits in Dubai or anywhere else in the UAE; that service runs only in India. For a Biology-strand specialist, the online model is what makes the match possible at all, because the pool is a subject pool rather than a map radius.
bullets: Opening five minutes: name the criterion and strand being worked on today
Middle forty: student rewrites their own work on a shared screen
Closing ten: one small task set, to be marked before the next session
Running criterion record kept, so progress is visible between reports

sections.heading: Academic honesty: what a tutor may and may not do with MYP work
paragraphs: The MYP is full of assessed work produced at home: investigation reports, interdisciplinary tasks, the Year 5 Personal Project. IB academic honesty rules require that work to be the student's own, and a tutor who blurs that line exposes the student rather than helping them. This is worth stating plainly, because the UAE search results for IB tutoring contain providers openly offering to supply finished coursework.

What a tutor may legitimately do is substantial. Teach the content. Explain a command term. Mark a draft against the published criterion descriptors and show where it falls short. Model a technique on a different example. Ask the questions that make a student notice their own gap. Teach referencing conventions and check that a bibliography is complete and consistent. Coach planning, time management and the reflective process behind a Personal Project. All of that is teaching, and all of it leaves the student's work theirs.

What a tutor must never do is produce or rewrite the assessed text, supply sentences to be copied into it, choose and complete the student's research for them, or edit a draft to the point where the voice is no longer the student's. The distinction a Dubai family can apply confidently is this: after the session, could your child explain every sentence in the document and why it is there. If yes, the help was teaching. If no, something has gone wrong, whoever provided it.

The same boundary applies to past papers and syllabus documents. Official IB, Cambridge and Pearson materials are copyright and should be accessed through the school or the board's own site rather than redistributed by a tutor. A good session uses the school's own tasks, the student's own data and freely available published descriptors, which is more useful anyway because it is the material the student is actually being marked on.
bullets: A tutor teaches, marks, explains and coaches process; the student writes
No tutoring arrangement should ever supply finished coursework or a Personal Project
Test of safety: your child can explain every sentence in the document
Board materials come from the school or the board's own site, not from a tutor

sections.heading: From MYP Year 5 Biology into the Diploma, and what to fix first
paragraphs: The move from MYP Year 5 Biology into Diploma Biology is not primarily a content jump. The biology broadens and deepens, but a student who has covered cells, transport, respiration, inheritance and ecology in the MYP has met most of the territory in outline. What changes is the assessment machinery: external papers with tightly defined command terms, quantitative data analysis, and a single internal assessment that must be a genuinely independent investigation rather than a teacher-set practical written up to a template.

Because of that, the students who find the first Diploma term manageable are the ones whose MYP criterion B and C marks were already strong. A student entering Year 12 with a 7 on criterion A and a 3 on criterion B has the knowledge and not the method, and the Diploma internal assessment will expose that within weeks. The reverse profile, solid method and patchy content, is the easier problem, because content can be learned on a schedule while investigative writing takes longer to build.

There is also a choice to make about level. Diploma Biology at Higher Level carries additional higher level material and a heavier load, and it is a common prerequisite for medicine and life-science degrees. Which universities require which level varies by country and by programme, and the only reliable source is the admissions page of the specific university. No tutoring arrangement should imply that a particular level guarantees an admission outcome, and no honest one will.

Practically, the useful work in MYP Year 5 is therefore not extra content coverage. It is closing criterion B and C gaps while there is still time, writing two or three investigations properly from research question to evaluation, and getting fluent with the command-term distinctions that the Diploma papers apply far more strictly. A student who arrives in Year 12 able to design, process and evaluate has bought themselves two years of easier Biology.
bullets: The Diploma jump is in assessment method, not mainly in biological content
Strong MYP criterion B and C marks predict an easier first Diploma term
Level choice depends on the specific university programme, checked on its own site
Best use of Year 5: two or three investigations written properly, start to finish

process.title: Send the marked work, not a description of the problem
process.description: The useful first message is two or three recently assessed Biology tasks with the criterion sheets attached, plus the school's name and your child's MYP year. That is enough to see which criterion is costing the grade. A written summary of the problem is far less diagnostic than one annotated script.

process.title: A short call to establish the school's model
process.description: Integrated Sciences or split strands, which year the split happens, whether the school registers for eAssessment, and when the next assessed task falls. These four answers decide the shape of the support. If you do not know them, the MYP coordinator will, and it is one email.

process.title: Free trial lesson with the real tutor
process.description: The trial is a working session, not a sales call: the tutor reads the marked work beforehand, teaches one criterion strand, and sets one small task. You see the teaching before paying for it. If the match is wrong, say so and a different tutor is proposed at no cost.

process.title: Agree the target criterion and the review point
process.description: Support works better with a named target: criterion C from 3 to 6 by the next assessed investigation, for example. Agree how long that should take and what evidence will show it. A vague goal of improving in Biology produces vague sessions and no way to judge them.

process.title: Weekly sessions with marked work in between
process.description: One session a week, one small written task between sessions, marked against the same criterion strands the school uses. The record of those marks is the progress report. It arrives weekly rather than termly, and it shows movement inside a band before the band itself changes.

process.title: Review honestly, including stopping
process.description: At the agreed review point, the criterion record either shows movement or it does not. If the weakness turns out to sit in mathematics or in written English rather than in Biology, that is said plainly and the plan changes. Support that is no longer needed should end, and we will say so.

whyPoints.title: Criterion descriptors, not a generic science syllabus
whyPoints.description: Tutors work from the MYP Sciences criteria and strands your child's school is actually marking against, which is why a session can name the specific loss point in a script. Support built on a general science syllabus cannot do that, because the marks are not awarded against a syllabus.

whyPoints.title: A Biology-strand specialist, not the nearest available tutor
whyPoints.description: Because lessons are online, the match is made from a subject pool rather than a travel radius. A student in Jumeirah Village Circle gets the same choice of MYP Sciences specialist as one in Emirates Hills, which is not true of any in-home arrangement in Dubai.

whyPoints.title: Teaching that starts from your child's own script
whyPoints.description: Every session opens with work the student produced and a teacher marked. That keeps the lesson anchored to the actual gap rather than to a tutor's preferred topic order, and it means the evidence of progress is in documents you already have.

whyPoints.title: Clear academic-honesty boundaries, stated up front
whyPoints.description: A tutor teaches, marks and coaches process. No part of an investigation report, interdisciplinary task or Personal Project is written for the student. We say this before the first session because the alternative puts a child's MYP record at risk.

whyPoints.title: Scheduling built around the Dubai school day
whyPoints.description: Sessions are set in Gulf Standard Time, typically between 16:00 and 20:30, and can move to post-Iftar slots during Ramadan. Nothing is lost to a school run or to traffic between communities, because nobody is travelling to the lesson.

whyPoints.title: A free trial before any money changes hands
whyPoints.description: The first lesson is a full working session with the tutor who would continue, at no charge and with no card details taken. Families decide after seeing the teaching rather than after reading a profile, and a wrong match costs nothing to correct.

faqs.question: What does MYP Biology actually get marked on in Dubai schools?
faqs.answer: On four criteria, each scored out of eight. Criterion A is knowing and understanding, criterion B is inquiring and designing, criterion C is processing and evaluating, and criterion D is reflecting on the impacts of science. Only criterion A rewards recalling biology. The other three reward designing a fair test, handling data and evaluating a method, and writing about applications of science in a balanced way. The four marks are added to give a total out of 32, and that total is read against a published boundary table to produce the 1 to 7 grade on the report. Your school's MYP coordinator holds the full descriptors and will share them on request.

faqs.question: Which of the four MYP Sciences criteria costs my child the most marks?
faqs.answer: In the marked work Dubai families send through, criteria B and C are the usual culprits. Criterion B losses come from research questions written as topics, hypotheses with no scientific reasoning, and variables listed but not controlled. Criterion C losses come from graphs without units, conclusions that restate the data instead of explaining it, and evaluations that name human error and stop. Both are writing and method problems rather than biology problems, which is why more content revision rarely moves the grade. Two or three marked tasks laid side by side show the pattern within minutes, and that pattern decides what the next six weeks should cover.

faqs.question: How is a 32-mark criterion total converted into an MYP grade of 1 to 7?
faqs.answer: The teacher takes a best-fit mark out of eight for each criterion, adds the four, and reads the total against the MYP grade-boundary table. Broadly, 28 to 32 gives a 7, 24 to 27 a 6, 19 to 23 a 5, 15 to 18 a 4, 10 to 14 a 3 and 6 to 9 a 2. Because each grade is a band, two students on the same grade can be several marks apart, and real progress can happen without the reported number changing. That is why criterion marks are a better progress measure than report grades. Confirm the exact boundaries in use with your child's MYP coordinator, since schools may apply interim versions internally.

faqs.question: My child is in MYP Year 4 Biology and slipping from a 6 to a 4. What changes that?
faqs.answer: A two-band drop at Year 4 is usually structural, not a sudden loss of knowledge. Year 4 is where assessment expectations step up, and in many Dubai schools it is also where integrated Sciences splits into separate strands, so Biology now carries its own full criterion set. The first move is to get the criterion sheets from the tasks either side of the drop and compare them. In most cases criterion A has held steady while B or C has fallen, which points at the investigation write-up rather than the biology. One investigation redrafted properly from research question to evaluation often recovers most of the distance.

faqs.question: Does an MYP Biology tutor need to know my child's school unit plans?
faqs.answer: Knowing the unit titles helps, but the criterion sheets matter far more. MYP units are framed by key and related concepts, so the same biology can appear under titles like Balance in the Body or Systems and Survival, and no two Dubai schools sequence them identically. What a tutor genuinely needs is the current unit's statement of inquiry, the assessment task, and the marked criterion sheet from the last task. With those three documents the teaching can be aligned precisely. Without them, a tutor is guessing at both the content and the strand being assessed, which is how sessions drift into general science revision.

faqs.question: What is criterion B in MYP Sciences and why do Dubai students lose marks on it?
faqs.answer: Criterion B is inquiring and designing: explaining a problem, writing a testable hypothesis with scientific reasoning behind it, explaining how variables will be manipulated and how enough relevant data will be collected, and designing a safe, logical method. Dubai MYP cohorts include many students who arrived from systems where experiments were given rather than designed, so this is often genuinely new rather than badly done. The commonest losses are a research question with nothing measurable in it, a prediction with no reason attached, and a method that lists controlled variables without saying how they are held constant. All three are fixable in a few focused sessions.

faqs.question: How does MYP Biology prepare a student for IB DP Biology HL?
faqs.answer: Better than most families expect on content and less well than they hope on method. The MYP covers cells, transport, respiration, inheritance and ecology in outline, so the Diploma broadens territory already visited. What the Diploma adds is externally examined papers with strict command terms, quantitative data handling, and an internal assessment that must be an independent investigation rather than a write-up of a set practical. Students entering Higher Level comfortably are almost always those whose MYP criterion B and C marks were strong. A student with a 7 on criterion A and a 3 on criterion B has the knowledge without the method, and the internal assessment will find that out quickly.

faqs.question: Can an MYP Biology tutor help with the scientific investigation write-up?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the highest-value work available, because criteria B and C together account for around half the criterion total. The help is teaching: marking the student's own draft against the published strands, explaining each loss, modelling a technique on a different data set, and setting the rewrite. The student does every draft themselves. Under IB academic honesty rules the report must be their own work, so no tutor should write sections, supply sentences to paste in, or edit a draft until the voice has changed. The test a parent can apply is simple: your child should be able to explain every sentence in the document and why it is there.

faqs.question: How many sessions a week does MYP Biology support usually need?
faqs.answer: One 60-minute session a week suits most MYP Biology cases, with one small written task marked in between. The between-session task is what makes weekly work effective; without it, each lesson restarts rather than builds. Two sessions a week is worth considering only in a narrow case, typically a short investigation clinic before a major assessed task, or a student who has joined a Dubai MYP cohort mid-year and is covering ground the class met last term. More than two is rarely productive at this age: the limiting factor is how much redrafting a student can absorb, not how many hours a tutor is available.

faqs.question: Are MYP Biology on-screen examinations marked differently from school tests?
faqs.answer: Schools that register for MYP eAssessment put Year 5 students through externally set on-screen examinations and moderated ePortfolios, leading to the IB MYP Certificate. Those papers are marked externally against the same four criteria, which makes criterion-literate writing even more valuable, because no teacher who knows the student is interpreting a thin answer generously. Schools that do not register assess Year 5 internally. Whether your child's school registers changes the entire shape of their final MYP year, including internal deadlines that fall months before any external window, so it is the first thing to establish with the coordinator.

faqs.question: Does my child need Biology tutoring if the school teaches integrated MYP Sciences?
faqs.answer: Possibly, but the first step is to separate the strands. An integrated Sciences grade of 4 can conceal a 6 in Biology sitting beside a 2 in Physics, and tutoring the wrong strand wastes a term. Ask the teacher which strand the lowest criterion marks came from, or send the last few marked tasks for a diagnostic read. Where Biology is genuinely the weak strand, support can be targeted at it inside the integrated course. Where the problem is a shared skill, usually investigation design or data handling, the work benefits every strand at once, which is a better use of the same hour.

faqs.question: How do command terms change the answer expected in MYP Biology?
faqs.answer: Substantially, and the describe-versus-explain distinction costs more MYP Biology marks than any other single confusion. Describe asks for an account of what happens; explain asks for the mechanism and the reasons. A student describing gas exchange lists alveoli, capillaries and thin walls. A student explaining it says the thin walls shorten the diffusion pathway, the capillary network maintains a steep concentration gradient, and ventilation keeps that gradient steep. Same knowledge, several marks apart. Analyse, evaluate and discuss carry the same trap higher up the mark range, where a one-sided answer can be accurate and still capped. Teaching the term and re-answering an attempted question is one of the fastest gains available.

faqs.question: Will an online MYP Biology tutor in Dubai cover practical skills?
faqs.answer: The handling of apparatus happens in the school laboratory, and that is where it belongs. What can be taught over live video is everything the criteria actually reward: designing the investigation before it is run, choosing a measurable variable, justifying repeats and sample size, building the results table, plotting and interpreting the graph, and writing an evaluation that names specific sources of error with their direction. Those are the strands criteria B and C are marked on. Students often return to the laboratory with a better plan than they left with, which improves the data they collect as well as the report they write about it.

faqs.question: What does criterion D, reflecting on the impacts of science, want from an MYP student?
faqs.answer: Three things: an explanation of how science is applied to address a specific problem, a discussion of the implications of using science that way, and correct use of scientific language and documentation conventions. In Biology the topics are familiar, selective breeding, vaccination, gene editing, conservation, antibiotic resistance. The marks are lost on balance and citation rather than on content. A one-sided case, however well written, caps the mark because discuss requires more than one position considered. Students who are strong in Individuals and Societies usually pick these marks up quickly once someone tells them the marks exist and shows them an in-text citation.

faqs.question: How soon can MYP Biology sessions start for a Dubai family?
faqs.answer: Usually within a few days of sending the marked work, because the match is made from a subject pool rather than from whoever is nearby. The sequence is short: you send two or three assessed tasks with criterion sheets, a tutor reads them, a free trial session is scheduled in Gulf Standard Time, and weekly work begins if the match is right. The honest exception is a narrow one. If no MYP Sciences specialist with Biology as a main strand has a suitable slot, we say so and give a realistic date rather than offering a generalist and calling it a specialist match.

faqs.question: What should I send a tutor before the first MYP Biology session?
faqs.answer: Four things, and none of them takes long to gather. The last two or three marked Biology or Sciences tasks with the criterion sheets and the teacher's annotations. The current unit's statement of inquiry or assessment brief, if your child has it. The school's name and your child's MYP year. The date of the next assessed task. With those, the first session can begin with teaching rather than with questions. If you can also tell us whether the school runs integrated Sciences or separate strands, and whether it registers for eAssessment, the plan can be built properly from the start.

dubai/ib-myp-biology-tutor.closingHeading: Start with the criterion sheets, not with more revision
dubai/ib-myp-biology-tutor.closingBody: If your child's MYP Biology grade has stalled, the answer is almost certainly written on a criterion sheet already in their school bag. Send two or three marked tasks and we will read them, name the strand that is costing the marks, and show you what a session would work on. The first lesson is free, delivered one-to-one over live video in Gulf Standard Time, with no card details and no commitment. If the evidence says the problem sits in mathematics or in written English rather than in Biology, we will tell you that instead of selling you Biology hours.

intro.heading: Chemistry marks are not lost at the bench, they are lost on the page afterwards
paragraphs: A parent watching a child struggle with chemistry reasonably concludes that chemistry needs demonstrating, and starts looking for someone to bring equipment to the house. It is an understandable instinct and it aims at the wrong target. MYP chemistry practical work happens at school, supervised, with school reagents, and it is assessed through what the student writes before and after it. Criterion B marks the plan. Criterion C marks the processing. Criterion D marks the reflection. None of those three is improved by a demonstration on a kitchen worktop.

What does improve them is specific and repeatable. A plan that names hazard and risk for each substance used, rather than ending with a line about wearing goggles. A titration table that discards the rough titre, keeps concordant results within a stated range and averages only those. A rate calculated from the gradient of a gas-volume curve rather than read off a single point. A mole conversion done before anything else, in writing, with units carried through. A reflection that cites one real source with a publisher and a date. Each of those is teachable in a session or two.

The quantitative spine is the part Dubai families most often underestimate. Four skills carry most MYP 4 and 5 chemistry marks: converting between mass and moles, using a balanced equation's coefficients as a ratio, calculating and using concentration, and averaging titres correctly. A student missing one of them will appear weak at rates of reaction, at neutralisation, at reacting masses and at anything on an exam paper with numbers in it. Topic-by-topic tutoring will treat four symptoms. The cause is one gap, and it is cheaper to fix at the source.

On the home-tutor question itself we should be plain. In-home chemistry tuition is available in this market, with published Dubai rates of roughly AED 180 to AED 350 an hour on Bestimate's 2026 table and independent listings up to AED 500, the travel carried inside the fee. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes in Dubai or anywhere else in the UAE. In-home teaching is a service we offer only in India. For UAE families everything is one-to-one over live video, scheduled in Gulf Standard Time around the school week.

For chemistry in particular that is not a compromise, and the safety point is worth stating directly. Reagents belong in a school laboratory with ventilation, supervision and disposal arrangements, and a tutor arriving with chemicals is a worse idea than it sounds. Meanwhile a shared screen does the thing chemistry marking actually requires: the task sheet, the rubric, the student's titration table and a live spreadsheet open together, with the mole conversion typed out where both people can see it go wrong.

dubai/ib-myp-chemistry-home-tutor.programmesIntro: Chemistry appears under different names and different levels of quantitative demand across a Dubai school career. What follows is what each stage asks the student to write, since writing is where the marks are awarded.

programmes.name: Chemistry inside integrated sciences
programmes.description: Particle model, states of matter, separation techniques, acids and alkalis qualitatively, and simple reaction types. Written demands are modest and heavily scaffolded: the table is often drawn, the variables often given. Marks go on precision rather than structure, chiefly units and the correct use of chemical names.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai cohorts arrive in MYP 1 from the PYP and from British and Indian primaries, and the difference shows in how comfortable students are writing their own method. The habit worth installing at this stage is writing state symbols and units as the work is done, because it is almost free now and expensive to retrofit in MYP 4.

programmes.name: MYP Chemistry as a separate subject
programmes.description: Bonding and structure, the mole and quantitative chemistry, rates of reaction, energetics in outline, acids and bases with titration, and introductory organic chemistry. Scaffolding is withdrawn: the student writes the hypothesis with a particle-level mechanism, names the hazards, chooses the processing and defends the conclusion.
programmes.countryNote: This is the band Dubai families ask about, and the titration investigation is the piece of work that most often arrives with a disappointing mark attached. In nearly every case the chemistry was performed correctly and the titre handling, the averaging rule and the concluding sentence were not written the way the descriptors require.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme Chemistry
programmes.description: Standard or Higher Level, with an internal assessment designed by the student and externally examined papers. Concentration, equilibrium, energetics and organic mechanisms all assume the mole arithmetic MYP 5 introduced, and uncertainty is assessed explicitly rather than mentioned in passing.
programmes.countryNote: Students in Dubai aiming at medicine or engineering abroad often need Higher Level Chemistry, and the MYP criterion C record is the most useful predictor available. Secure recall with weak independent processing is the profile that struggles first, because the internal assessment arrives before the content is finished.

programmes.name: Cambridge and Pearson IGCSE Chemistry
programmes.description: Where a Dubai student sits IGCSE Chemistry such as Cambridge 0620 rather than completing MYP 5, assessment is terminal and externally marked, with no criterion coursework. The quantitative content overlaps closely with MYP 4 and 5; the written demands around planning and evaluation do not.
programmes.countryNote: Transfers in both directions are routine here, since British-curriculum schools hold 37 per cent of Dubai private school enrolment. Cambridge runs June and November series and allocates every centre to one of six administrative zones, with the zone timetable governing the dates, so a transfer needs the receiving school's exams officer involved early.

dubai/ib-myp-chemistry-home-tutor.subjectsIntro: Below is MYP chemistry written as the work a session actually does, with the marks each piece protects. Every line can be checked against your child's own returned work this evening.

subjects.name: Mass to moles and moles to mass
subjects.description: Dividing mass by relative formula mass and the reverse, written out with units rather than done mentally. The commonest single failure in MYP chemistry, and the dependency behind reacting masses, concentration and almost every quantitative examination question.

subjects.name: Concentration in moles per cubic decimetre
subjects.description: Converting cubic centimetres to cubic decimetres before dividing, which is where most answers go wrong by a factor of a thousand. The habit that fixes it is converting volume first, on a separate line, before any division happens.

subjects.name: Balanced equations as a working ratio
subjects.description: Most students balance competently and then ignore the coefficients when calculating. Teaching the ratio step explicitly, moles of A to moles of B before any mass is calculated, recovers marks across reacting mass and titration questions alike.

subjects.name: Titration technique and titre handling
subjects.description: Discarding the rough titration, judging which results are concordant, averaging only those, and recording to the resolution of the burette. Rarely taught explicitly and frequently assessed, which makes it the highest-value hour in MYP 4 chemistry.

subjects.name: Rates of reaction and the gradient
subjects.description: Collision theory explanations plus the gradient of a gas-volume or mass-loss curve. The chemistry is usually understood and the gradient is usually read from one point, which is a graph error that costs criterion C marks on every rates investigation.

subjects.name: Energetics and the sign convention
subjects.description: Exothermic and endothermic changes and energy level diagrams. The error is almost always the sign rather than the concept, which means a single session with several worked diagrams usually settles it for good.

subjects.name: Hazard, risk and a safe method
subjects.description: Naming the hazard of each substance, the risk it creates in this specific procedure, and the control that reduces it. A method ending with wear goggles is a middle-band method; one that names dilute acid, splash risk to eyes and the control that addresses it is not.

subjects.name: Criterion C processing in chemistry
subjects.description: Averaging concordant values, converting mass change into moles, calculating a rate, presenting results to a consistent resolution, and writing a conclusion that names the hypothesis. The largest pool of recoverable marks in the subject.

subjects.name: Criterion D reflection with UAE contexts
subjects.description: Applying chemistry to a named local problem and documenting sources properly. Desalination brine, refrigerants in district cooling, construction dust, plastics in Gulf waters and treated effluent reuse are all genuinely local and all under-used.

subjects.name: Chemical language and state symbols
subjects.description: Formulae with correct subscripts, state symbols in equations, and units on every quantity. Small, repeated losses that are invisible in one script and significant across a year, which is why this is drilled early rather than revised late.

sections.heading: The mole: the arithmetic that decides whether MYP chemistry works
paragraphs: If a student is weak at reacting masses, at concentration, at titration processing and at rate calculations, that is not four problems. It is one problem appearing four times, and the problem is the mole. Converting between mass and moles using relative formula mass is the single dependency behind the whole quantitative half of MYP 4 and 5 chemistry, and a student who performs it hesitantly will fail at everything built on top of it while appearing to have a general chemistry weakness.

The fix is procedural and it is quick. Write the quantity with its unit. Write the relative formula mass, calculated from the periodic table rather than remembered. Divide, with the unit of the answer written down. Then use the balanced equation's coefficients as a ratio to find moles of the other substance, and only then convert back to mass. Five lines, always in the same order, written out even when the student thinks they can do it mentally. Mental arithmetic is where the factor-of-ten errors come from.

Concentration is the same procedure with one extra trap. Volumes arrive in cubic centimetres and concentration is in moles per cubic decimetre, so the volume conversion has to happen on its own line before any division. Students who skip that line produce answers out by a factor of a thousand and accept them, because they have no expectation of what the answer should be. We teach a magnitude estimate first: should this be about a tenth of a mole or about a hundred. That single habit catches most of the remaining errors.
bullets: Write the unit on every line, including intermediate values
Calculate relative formula mass from the periodic table, do not recall it
Use the balanced equation as a mole ratio before converting back to mass

sections.heading: Titration data: what criterion C actually wants from a set of titres
paragraphs: The titration investigation is the piece of MYP 4 chemistry work most likely to come back with a mark that surprises the family, and the reason is almost always that nobody taught titre handling explicitly. The practical was performed well. The chemistry was right. The table and the averaging were written the way a sensible person would write them rather than the way the descriptors require, and criterion C marks the table.

The sequence the descriptors reward is specific. The rough titration is recorded and then excluded from the average, with a sentence saying why. The remaining titres are examined for concordance within a stated range, commonly 0.10 cubic centimetres, and only concordant values are averaged. Readings are recorded to the resolution of the burette, consistently, including trailing zeros. The mean titre is then used in the calculation, and the calculation is shown with units on every line. The table below sets out each step against what students typically do instead.

What makes this such good value as a session is that it transfers completely. Every titration the student performs for the rest of the programme, and in Diploma Programme Chemistry afterwards, uses the same handling. One hour on a returned titration write-up, redrafting the student's own table and recalculating from the corrected mean, usually moves criterion C by a band and never needs repeating. It is also the clearest possible demonstration to a parent of what a session does, because the before and after sit on one page.

sections.heading: Balanced equations: coefficients are a ratio, not decoration
paragraphs: Almost every MYP 4 student can balance an equation. Far fewer use the balanced equation when calculating, which is a strange gap and a very common one. Asked how much product forms from a given mass of reactant, students convert the reactant to moles correctly and then convert straight back to mass using the product's formula mass, skipping the ratio entirely. The answer is wrong by exactly the factor the coefficients would have supplied.

The reason, as far as we can tell from working with students in this city, is that balancing is taught as a puzzle and calculating is taught as a procedure, and nobody joins them. The join takes one session. Take a balanced equation the student has already written, label the coefficients as moles rather than as numbers, and work two calculations side by side: one where the ratio is one to one and one where it is one to two. Seeing the same procedure produce different answers because of the ratio is what makes the step stick.

The same gap damages limiting-reagent questions, which appear in outline in MYP 5 and properly in Diploma Programme Chemistry. A student who does not treat coefficients as a ratio cannot determine which reactant runs out first, because the comparison is a ratio comparison. Fixing the ratio habit in MYP 4 therefore pays twice: once in the immediate reacting-mass questions, and again two years later when limiting reagents arrive with no time allowed for revisiting the basics.

Work a one-to-one and a one-to-two example side by side

sections.heading: Criterion D in chemistry: six UAE contexts and the sources to cite
paragraphs: Criterion D asks the student to apply chemistry to a specific problem or issue, discuss the implications of using science to address it, and document sources correctly. Students in Dubai routinely choose a global topic from the first page of search results, write generally about plastic or climate, and land in the middle bands because the discussion could have been written anywhere by anyone. The upper bands reward specificity, and specificity is available locally for free.

The table lists six contexts that are genuinely local, each with the chemistry inside it and the kind of implication worth discussing. Desalination is the obvious one and still under-used: the chemistry of brine concentration and the energy required per cubic metre of fresh water are both real chemistry and visibly relevant to a country that produces much of its drinking water this way. Refrigerants in district cooling, construction dust composition, treated effluent reuse in landscaping, panel soiling and cleaning chemistry, and corrosion in a humid coastal atmosphere all work similarly.

Then the documentation, which sinks more good criterion D work than weak chemistry does. Sources must be cited consistently in the school's required style, in the text as well as in the list at the end. One source with a named publisher and a date outscores four uncited assertions. This is also where academic-honesty boundaries matter: a tutor questions the argument, points at an unsupported claim and explains how to cite it properly. A tutor never supplies sentences for a student to submit. Every word of an MYP task, and of a Personal Project, must be the student's own.

sections.heading: Rates of reaction: a graph problem wearing a chemistry costume
paragraphs: Rates of reaction is the MYP chemistry topic where students most often understand the chemistry and still lose the marks. Collision theory is usually secure: more concentrated means more frequent collisions, hotter means more energetic collisions, smaller pieces mean more surface area, a catalyst lowers the energy barrier. Asked to explain any of those, a well-taught MYP 4 student answers correctly. Asked to find the rate from their gas-volume curve, the same student reads one point and divides.

The rate is a gradient, and a gradient is a change divided by a change. On a gas-volume curve the initial rate is the gradient of the tangent at the start, which most MYP schemes simplify to the gradient over the first interval, read with two widely spaced points on the line rather than two data points. Students who have met gradients in mathematics often do not transfer the skill, because here the axes have units and the answer has a chemical name, so we teach it on the student's own curve.

The second loss in this topic is the comparison. A rates investigation usually produces several curves at different concentrations, and criterion C wants the relationship described and quantified, not just observed. Saying that the higher concentration reacted faster earns little; calculating the initial rate for each curve and showing how the rate changes with concentration is the processing step the descriptors describe. That is one session's work on a returned investigation and it generalises to every rates task afterwards.
bullets: Rate is a gradient: a change divided by a change, read off the axes
Use two widely spaced points on the line, not two data points
Calculate an initial rate for each curve, then compare them numerically
Describing which curve was faster is observation, not processing

sections.heading: Hazard, risk and control: what a safe method must actually say
paragraphs: Criterion B requires a method that is safe as well as replicable, and this is the strand where a whole band is routinely lost to a single missing sentence. The typical MYP 4 plan ends with a line about wearing safety goggles and a lab coat. That is a precaution, not a risk assessment, and it earns little because it would be true of any practical in any subject.

What the upper bands describe is specific to the substances in this procedure. Name the substance. Name its hazard, for example that dilute hydrochloric acid is irritant. Name the risk created by this particular procedure, for example splashing into the eyes while filling a burette at eye level. Then name the control that reduces it, which might be filling the burette with a funnel below eye level, and say what to do if it happens anyway. Four short clauses per substance, and a plan that reads as though the student has thought about their own experiment rather than copied a template.

There is a second element students almost always omit, which is disposal. A plan that produces a neutralised salt solution or an acidic residue should say how it is dealt with, because disposal is part of a safe method and it is easy to write once you know it is wanted. These are not chemistry insights, they are writing instructions, and that is exactly why they are cheap to teach and expensive to leave alone. One session on a returned plan, rewritten by the student with hazard, risk, control and disposal for each substance, usually fixes the strand permanently.
bullets: Name the substance, its hazard, the risk in this procedure, and the control
Goggles and a lab coat alone are a precaution, not a risk assessment
Say what happens if the risk materialises
Include disposal of residues; it is part of a safe method

sections.heading: MYP 5 chemistry into Diploma Programme Chemistry: four things to fix first
paragraphs: The step into Diploma Programme Chemistry is steeper than the step into DP Biology, and the reason is quantitative. The mole arithmetic MYP 5 introduces is assumed from the first week, concentration and dilution calculations appear immediately, uncertainty is assessed explicitly rather than mentioned, and the internal assessment requires the student to design something answerable with school apparatus and to process its data unaided.

Four things are therefore worth fixing in the final MYP 5 terms, and all four are cheaper now than in the middle of a Diploma year with five other subjects competing. First, mole and concentration fluency to the point of automaticity, including the volume conversion. Second, significant figures and instrument resolution, since both are assessed directly in the Diploma. Third, writing a research question narrow enough to answer with the equipment a school actually has, which is the most common internal assessment failure. Fourth, processing data without being told which calculation to use.

If you are weighing DP Chemistry against A Level Chemistry at the end of MYP 5 in Dubai, the useful evidence is the criterion record rather than the overall grade. Strong criterion A with weak criterion C means secure recall and shaky independent processing, and that profile meets the hardest part of the Diploma first, because the internal assessment arrives before the content is complete. Ask the MYP coordinator for the strand marks, and treat them as information about independence rather than about how much chemistry the student knows.
bullets: Mole and concentration fluency, including the volume conversion, to automaticity
Significant figures and instrument resolution, both assessed directly in the Diploma
A research question answerable with the school's own apparatus
Processing data without being told which calculation to apply

process.title: Send the returned titration or rates write-up
process.description: Of all the documents a Dubai MYP chemistry student produces, the returned titration or rates investigation is the most diagnostic. A photograph with the rubric is enough. We read it before the first session and open on the titre handling or the gradient, which is usually where the marks went.

process.title: Free trial lesson, with the condition stated
process.description: One forty-five-minute online session at no charge, with no card details taken and nothing to cancel afterwards. The tutor works on the piece you sent and finishes with a written note naming the specific step that lost the marks. The note is yours whether or not anything follows it.

process.title: Fix the quantitative spine before the topics
process.description: Where the errors sit in mole conversion, the equation ratio or concentration, we drill those in a fixed block of four to six sessions inside real chemistry questions. The student writes their own reference card. Several topics usually improve at once, because one gap had been making all of them fail.

process.title: Redraft one returned piece against the descriptors
process.description: The student rewrites a previously marked investigation, adding hazard, risk, control and disposal, excluding the rough titre, averaging only concordant values and separating the conclusion from the evaluation. Two drafts on one page is the clearest evidence of progress available mid-term.

process.title: Review at half term and plan the interruptions
process.description: At half term we compare marked work against the baseline and recommend continuing, reducing to fortnightly or stopping. School examination weeks are pause weeks. During Ramadan, sessions move to post-Iftar or a late weekend morning and shorten to forty-five minutes. Planning that in advance is what keeps a term's plan intact.

whyPoints.title: The quantitative spine is diagnosed first
whyPoints.description: Four skills carry most MYP chemistry marks: mass to moles, the equation ratio, concentration with its volume conversion, and titre averaging. A student weak in one looks weak in four topics. We count the error types before recommending anything, and the answer is often a fixed six-session block rather than a year of weekly chemistry.

whyPoints.title: Work on the student's own readings
whyPoints.description: Sessions run on the titration table the student wrote and the curve they plotted, with the rubric open beside it on a shared screen. Redrafting a returned piece against the descriptors produces a before-and-after pair that a parent can read in two minutes without knowing any chemistry.

whyPoints.title: Local contexts for criterion D
whyPoints.description: Desalination brine, district cooling refrigerants, construction dust, treated effluent reuse, panel soiling and coastal corrosion are all genuinely local and all under-used. A reflection on one of them with a dated, named source outscores a generic global statistic, which is what most students submit instead.

whyPoints.title: The student writes every word
whyPoints.description: A tutor questions a plan, challenges a hazard statement, processes data alongside the student and gives written feedback on a draft. Nothing is supplied for submission, in an investigation, a Personal Project or anywhere else. Being explicit about that protects the student from a finding that lasts longer than any mark.

We hold no accreditation from KHDA, the IB, Cambridge or Pearson and claim none, and we publish no IB examination dates because the IB's own site cannot be verified automatically.

faqs.question: Will a chemistry tutor bring equipment to our home in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Not from IB Gram, and we would advise against it generally. MYP practical work belongs in a school laboratory with supervision, ventilation and proper disposal, and reagents in an apartment are a bad idea whatever the marking scheme says. We do not provide in-home visits anywhere in the UAE; that service runs only in India. For Dubai families teaching is one-to-one over live video. The marks in MYP chemistry are awarded on the plan, the processing and the reflection, and all three are written documents rather than demonstrations.

faqs.question: Why did my child lose marks on a titration they performed correctly?
faqs.answer: Because criterion C marks the table, not the technique. The sequence the descriptors want is specific: record the rough titration and exclude it from the mean with a sentence saying why, then average only titres that are concordant within a stated range, commonly 0.10 cubic centimetres, recorded consistently to the burette's resolution including trailing zeros, with the mean carried at full precision into the calculation. Most students average everything and round early. One session redrafting their own table usually moves the strand by a band and never needs repeating.

faqs.question: What does concordant actually mean in a MYP titration?
faqs.answer: Titres close enough together to be treated as agreeing, within a range the student states explicitly, commonly 0.10 cubic centimetres in school practice. The point is the judgement rather than the number: criterion C wants to see that the student examined the spread of their results and decided which were reliable, rather than averaging whatever appeared in the table. Ask your child to show you their titre values and tell you which ones they averaged and why. If the answer is all of them, that is the mark that went missing.

faqs.question: My child can balance equations but gets reacting mass questions wrong. Why?
faqs.answer: Because the coefficients are being treated as part of a puzzle rather than as a mole ratio. The student converts the reactant mass to moles correctly, then converts straight back to mass using the product's formula mass and skips the ratio, so the answer is wrong by exactly the factor the coefficients would have supplied. The fix takes one session: label the coefficients as moles and work a one-to-one example beside a one-to-two example, so the student sees the same procedure give different answers because of the ratio.

faqs.question: Why are my child's concentration answers out by a factor of a thousand?
faqs.answer: The volume conversion. Concentration is in moles per cubic decimetre and volumes arrive in cubic centimetres, so the conversion has to happen on its own line before any division. Students who do it mentally, or not at all, produce an answer a thousand times too large or too small and accept it, because they have no expectation of the right magnitude. We teach the conversion as a separate written line and add a magnitude estimate beforehand, which catches almost all of the remaining errors.

faqs.question: What should a safe method say in a MYP chemistry plan?
faqs.answer: Four clauses for each substance used. Name the substance. Name its hazard, for instance that dilute acid is irritant. Name the risk this specific procedure creates, such as splashing while filling a burette at eye level. Name the control that reduces it. Then say what to do if it happens anyway, and add how residues are disposed of. A plan that ends with wear goggles and a lab coat is giving a precaution rather than a risk assessment, and it sits in the middle bands for that reason alone.

faqs.question: How does a tutor help with rates of reaction if the practical is at school?
faqs.answer: By teaching the part that is marked. Collision theory explanations are usually secure in a well-taught MYP 4 cohort. The marks go missing on the curve: the rate is a gradient, read as a change divided by a change using two widely spaced points on the line, not one data point divided. Then criterion C wants the several curves compared numerically, with an initial rate calculated for each, rather than a sentence saying which went faster. Both are done live on the student's own graph.

faqs.question: Which local topics work best for a criterion D chemistry reflection?
faqs.answer: Six work well and are all under-used: desalination and brine disposal, refrigerants in district cooling, construction dust composition, treated effluent used for landscape irrigation, solar panel soiling and cleaning chemistry, and corrosion in a humid coastal atmosphere. Each contains real chemistry and has implications you can discuss for people living here, which is what the upper bands describe. Then cite one source with a named publisher and a date, in the school's referencing style, in the text as well as in the list.

faqs.question: Is organic chemistry worth tutoring in MYP 5 or can it wait?
faqs.answer: It is worth starting, though it is lower priority than the mole arithmetic. MYP 5 organic chemistry is mostly new vocabulary and pattern recognition, homologous series, naming simple alkanes and alkenes, and a few reactions, and it is the foundation of the most demanding section of Diploma Programme Chemistry. If the quantitative work is already secure, spending the final MYP 5 term on organic naming and simple mechanisms is a sound investment. If the mole arithmetic is still shaky, fix that first; organic chemistry without it leads nowhere.

faqs.question: How many sessions does the titration and processing work take?
faqs.answer: Usually two to three. One session redrafting a returned titration table, covering the rough titre, concordance, resolution and the carried mean. One on the calculation itself, with the volume conversion and the equation ratio written out line by line. Sometimes a third applying the same handling to a rates curve, since the processing logic is similar. It transfers completely to every titration the student performs afterwards, including in the Diploma Programme, which is why it is the best-value hour in MYP 4 chemistry.

faqs.question: Can a tutor check my child's chemistry investigation before they submit it?
faqs.answer: A tutor can read the draft, question the hypothesis, challenge the hazard statements, check that the processing matches the data and give written feedback against the descriptors. What a tutor must never do is supply any text that is submitted, in a chemistry investigation, a Personal Project or any assessed piece. Every word has to be the student's own. That boundary is not a formality: outsourced work is an academic-honesty breach with consequences for the student that outlast any criterion mark, and it is the practice this market's essay sellers depend on.

faqs.question: Is DP Chemistry a bigger step than DP Biology after MYP 5?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, and the reason is quantitative. Diploma Chemistry assumes the mole arithmetic from the first week, brings concentration and dilution calculations in immediately, assesses uncertainty and significant figures explicitly, and requires an internal assessment the student designs and processes unaided. A student whose MYP 5 criterion C record is weak meets the hardest part first. Ask the MYP coordinator for the strand marks before choosing, and read them as evidence about independent processing rather than about how much chemistry is known.

faqs.question: What should we fix in the final MYP 5 chemistry terms?
faqs.answer: Four things, roughly twelve sessions across two terms. Mole and concentration fluency to the point where the volume conversion happens automatically. Significant figures and instrument resolution, because both post-16 routes assess them directly. Writing a research question narrow enough to answer with the apparatus a school actually owns, which is the most common internal assessment failure. And processing data without being told which calculation to apply. All four cost far less now than in the middle of a Diploma year.

faqs.question: Do we need a tutor who has taught the specific exam board our school uses?
faqs.answer: For MYP work what matters is criterion experience rather than board familiarity, because schools write their own criterion tasks within the programme framework and the rubric wording differs by campus. Ask which criterion strands the tutor has marked and at which year group, and insist that sessions work from your school's task sheet rather than the tutor's own materials. If your child is sitting Cambridge or Pearson IGCSE Chemistry instead, then syllabus specificity matters and you should ask about the particular syllabus code.

intro.heading: A chemistry hour in Dubai is sold as a number; here is what the number contains
paragraphs: Published hourly rates for science tuition in Dubai span from AED 33 to AED 650, which is a factor of twenty for something described in identical words on every website. Tutopiya lists online sessions from AED 33 to AED 52 and EdFlik from AED 45 to AED 65. Unitors publishes IGCSE support from AED 150 and IB support from AED 200. TutorChase quotes around AED 270. Bestimate's 2026 Dubai rate table puts in-home one-to-one at AED 180 to AED 350 and subject specialists at AED 200 to AED 450 and above. BartyED publishes AED 650 for a premium named tutor. All of those are the providers' own figures, read in October 2026.

What no page in this market publishes is what the hour contains, and that is where the money is decided. An hour can be a generic lesson on rates of reaction delivered to a student whose actual problem is converting grams to moles. It can be a marked script reviewed error by error. It can be ninety minutes of a tutor's evening spent driving, of which you pay for sixty. The hourly rate tells you none of this. The questions in this page are designed to extract it before you commit, because almost nobody volunteers it.

Chemistry is also the science where paying for the wrong hour is most expensive. MYP chemistry has a quantitative spine: the mole, concentration, mass calculations, limiting reagents in outline, and the processing of titration or mass-change data under criterion C. A student who cannot do that arithmetic will fail at reaction rates, at acids and bases, and at anything involving a balanced equation with numbers attached, and will present as weak at chemistry generally. Buy topic teaching for that student and you pay for explanations they already follow while the obstacle sits untouched.

The context in Dubai is unusually favourable for planning rather than panicking. KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that there will be no increase in private school fees in the emirate for the 2026-27 academic year, under the second of Dubai's economic incentives packages valued at AED 1.5 billion within an AED 2.5 billion total. For many households the school line is flat for the first time in several years. The sensible use of that is a planned two-year chemistry budget across MYP 4 and 5, not an emergency block of specialist hours in the spring.

So this page compares provider models on their own published rates, writes out three two-year budgets with the assumptions visible, lists the billing terms that turn a quoted rate into a different monthly number, and says where a small remaining budget before an assessment actually returns something. IB Gram's own model is one-to-one teaching over live video with a free trial lesson before anything is paid for. We do not provide in-home visits anywhere in the UAE; that service runs in India only.

dubai/ib-myp-chemistry-tutor.programmesIntro: The cost of chemistry support changes stage by stage, and not in a straight line. The steepest increase is not at the Diploma Programme, where families expect it, but at the start of MYP 4, where they rarely do. Here is what each stage asks for and what it tends to cost.

programmes.name: Chemistry inside integrated sciences
programmes.description: Particle model, states of matter, mixtures and separation, acids and alkalis qualitatively, and simple reaction types. The arithmetic is light, so a careful generalist teaches this well and the budget tier of the market is genuinely adequate here. Support at this stage is usually one term, aimed at a habit rather than at content.
programmes.countryNote: In Dubai this is the cheapest place to spend money on chemistry and the place where spending it pays off longest, because unit discipline and the reading of a balanced equation both start here. A single term of weekly sessions in MYP 2 or MYP 3 frequently removes the need for a specialist in MYP 4 altogether.

programmes.name: MYP Chemistry as a separate subject
programmes.description: Bonding, the mole and quantitative chemistry, rates of reaction, energetics in outline, acids and bases with titration work, and the beginnings of organic chemistry. Criterion tasks are unscaffolded and criterion C now demands processed data rather than recorded data. This is where rates move from the budget tier to the qualified tier.
programmes.countryNote: Most Dubai continuum schools split the sciences at MYP 4, so a household that was paying for one science tutor meets three subject teachers, three rubrics and three deadlines in the same fortnight. Families who budget for one specialist plus two diagnostic sessions, rather than three weekly slots, spend roughly half as much and finish the term.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme Chemistry
programmes.description: Standard or Higher Level, with an internal assessment designed by the student and externally examined papers. The quantitative demand rises sharply: concentration, equilibrium, energetics and organic mechanisms all assume the mole arithmetic that MYP 5 introduced. Specialist rates apply here, and the published Dubai specialist band runs from AED 200 to AED 450 and above.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai students aiming at medicine or engineering abroad frequently need Higher Level Chemistry, which concentrates demand on a thin pool of specialists and pushes rates towards the upper end of the published band. Securing a regular slot early in Year 12 costs less than buying blocks of hours in the final two terms.

programmes.name: Cambridge and Pearson IGCSE Chemistry
programmes.description: Where a Dubai student sits IGCSE Chemistry instead of finishing MYP 5, for instance Cambridge 0620, the assessment is terminal and externally marked with no criterion coursework. Rates for IGCSE support sit below IB rates in this market: Unitors publishes IGCSE from AED 150 against IB from AED 200.
programmes.countryNote: That AED 50 gap between published IGCSE and IB rates is a useful signal about supply. British-curriculum schools hold 37 per cent of Dubai private school enrolment against 7 per cent for IB programmes, so IGCSE chemistry tutors are plentiful and MYP-experienced chemistry tutors are not. Price follows scarcity rather than difficulty.

dubai/ib-myp-chemistry-tutor.subjectsIntro: What follows is MYP chemistry as the work actually sits in a session, with a note on how expensive each piece is to fix. Cheap here means a few sessions with lasting effect; expensive means genuine content teaching over several weeks.

subjects.name: The mole, mass and concentration
subjects.description: Grams to moles, moles to grams, and concentration in moles per cubic decimetre. Cheap to fix and devastating when missing, because every quantitative topic downstream depends on it. Four to six sessions of drilling usually settles it for the rest of the programme.

subjects.name: Balancing equations and reacting masses
subjects.description: Balancing is usually secure; using the balanced ratio to calculate a reacting mass is not. Students treat the coefficients as decoration. Cheap to fix once the link between the equation and the arithmetic is made explicit with worked pairs.

subjects.name: Bonding and structure
subjects.description: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding and the properties that follow from each. Moderately expensive, because the explanations are genuinely conceptual and because the explain command term demands a mechanism rather than a description of the property.

subjects.name: Rates of reaction
subjects.description: Collision theory, the effect of concentration, temperature, surface area and catalysts, and the gradient of a gas-volume curve. Cheap in theory and expensive in practice, because the gradient reading belongs to criterion C and is a graph skill rather than a chemistry one.

subjects.name: Acids, bases and titration data
subjects.description: Neutralisation, pH qualitatively, and the processing of titre values including discarding a rough titration and averaging concordant results. Cheap to fix and frequently untaught, so it is often the single best value session in the whole MYP 4 chemistry year.

subjects.name: Energetics in outline
subjects.description: Exothermic and endothermic changes, energy level diagrams, and the sign convention that trips most students. Cheap, because the error is almost always the sign rather than the concept, and a single session with six worked diagrams usually settles it.

subjects.name: Introductory organic chemistry
subjects.description: Homologous series, naming simple alkanes and alkenes, and the basic reactions. Moderately expensive, since it is new vocabulary and new pattern recognition at once, but it also prepares the ground for the most demanding section of DP Chemistry.

subjects.name: Criterion B chemistry investigation design
subjects.description: Hypothesis with a particle-level mechanism, variables named with the method of control, and a method that addresses hazard explicitly. Expensive per hour and cheap over time, because the same corrections apply to every investigation the student will design afterwards.

subjects.name: Criterion C processing of chemistry data
subjects.description: Averaging concordant titres, calculating a rate from a gradient, converting mass change into moles, and writing a conclusion that names the hypothesis. The largest pool of mechanically recoverable marks in MYP chemistry, and therefore the best value target.

subjects.name: Chemical language and symbol conventions
subjects.description: State symbols, formulae written with correct subscripts, and units on every quantity. Marks are lost here in small amounts across every paper, which makes it invisible in any single script and significant across a year. Cheap, and worth drilling early.

sections.heading: What an IB MYP chemistry tutor in Dubai costs by provider model
paragraphs: Comparing tutors by hourly rate alone is close to useless, because the models behind the rates differ in what they include. A marketplace rate excludes the vetting an agency does. An agency rate includes an account manager you may never speak to. An in-home rate includes a car. A tuition-centre monthly package includes a venue and a group. The table below compares the models rather than brands, and quotes published rates with their source and the month they were read, which is the only honest way to put numbers next to each other.

Two columns deserve explanation. The examiner column exists because premium pricing in this market is frequently justified by examiner experience, and that claim is rarely evidenced. We do not describe our tutors as IB or Cambridge examiners, because current examiner status is not something we can verify for an individual, and examiner status should never be used to imply access to marking, boundaries or paper content. If a provider charges AED 650 on the strength of it, ask what evidence they will show you.

The permit column exists because it is checkable and free. The MoHRE private tuition work permit is granted at no cost for two years under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, which means a tutor without one has no financial excuse. Ask to see it. The replacement and trial columns matter because they determine what a mismatch costs you: if the answer to a bad match is a refund argument rather than a different tutor next week, the quoted rate understates the real risk.

sections.heading: A two-year MYP 4 and 5 chemistry budget, written out in three scenarios
paragraphs: Chemistry support is almost always bought one term at a time and almost always costs more that way, because reactive buying happens at the worst moment and at the worst rate. The alternative is to decide now what the two MYP years will contain. The table sets out three scenarios with their assumptions exposed, using the published Dubai qualified-tutor band of roughly AED 150 to AED 300 an hour so the figures can be checked against the market rather than taken on trust.

The lean scenario is the one most families underestimate. A quantitative block in the first half of MYP 4, then fortnightly maintenance, then a short block before the MYP 5 assessment, covers a surprising number of students. It works because the mole arithmetic is the real obstacle for most of them and it only needs fixing once. The middle scenario adds a weekly slot through MYP 4 for students who also need bonding and energetics taught properly. The intensive scenario is for students entering MYP 4 significantly behind.

Read the assumption column as carefully as the totals. Each scenario assumes sessions are paused rather than added during school examination weeks, that Ramadan sessions run shorter at post-Iftar or weekend times, and that the plan is reviewed each half term against marked work. Those three assumptions are what make the totals achievable; a plan that ignores them typically delivers two-thirds of the sessions at full price. Bestimate's own monthly estimates give a cross-check: AED 240 to AED 600 a month at the budget tier, AED 600 to AED 1,200 mid-tier, and AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 and above for specialist support in an assessment year.

sections.heading: Why chemistry costs more than biology in this market
paragraphs: Families comparing quotes across the three sciences in MYP 4 often find chemistry priced above biology by a visible margin, and assume it reflects difficulty. It reflects supply. A tutor who can teach MYP biology needs secure subject knowledge and good command-term discipline. A tutor who can teach MYP chemistry needs those plus fluent quantitative handling, because half the marks in MYP 4 and 5 chemistry sit behind arithmetic that the biology syllabus barely touches.

The pool narrows further in Dubai specifically. International Baccalaureate programmes account for 7 per cent of private school enrolment in the emirate, against 37 per cent for British curricula and 26 per cent for Indian ones. A chemistry tutor in this city has almost certainly taught Cambridge 0620 or CBSE chemistry more often than they have marked an MYP criterion C titration table. The published gap between IGCSE and IB rates, about AED 50 an hour on one provider's own pages, is the market pricing that scarcity rather than pricing the subject.

The practical consequence is about timing rather than negotiation. Rates in a scarce segment do not fall when you ask; availability simply disappears first at the affordable end. Families who secure a chemistry slot in September pay the band's middle. Families looking in March, when every MYP 5 cohort in the city wants the same six weeks, pay the band's top or take whoever is left. If the budget is fixed, the lever that actually works is booking early and buying fewer, better-targeted hours, not haggling.

sections.heading: Six billing terms that decide what an hourly rate really costs
paragraphs: The gap between a quoted hourly rate and a monthly bill is made up of terms almost nobody asks about. Settle all six in writing before the first paid session and the monthly figure stops surprising you. None of these questions is rude; a provider who answers all six without hesitation is the one worth dealing with, and a provider who deflects two of them has told you something useful at no cost.

On tax specifically, keep the question narrow. The UAE VAT treatment of tuition depends on the provider's registration and the nature of the service, and no page should state another provider's tax position as fact. What a parent is entitled to is a plain answer about the figure in front of them: is this the amount payable, and does it include any tax. Get it in writing alongside the other five answers.

The term families regret skipping most often is the prepaid block. A discount for buying twenty hours is attractive in September and expensive in February when the student no longer needs twenty hours, or when the tutor becomes unavailable. Ask what happens to unused sessions, whether they expire, and whether they transfer to a different tutor or a different subject. The same applies to a stated free trial: if it is free, the condition attached to it should be visible on the same screen, which is why ours is written as one forty-five-minute session with no card details taken.

sections.heading: Group chemistry classes: when a lower rate per head is good value
paragraphs: Group rates in this market sit at roughly AED 70 to AED 130 an hour per student at MYP 4 and 5 level, and tuition centres advertise monthly packages from about AED 799. Against an individual qualified rate of AED 150 to AED 300 that looks decisive, and for some work it is. For other work it is money spent on a seat in a room.

Group work is good value when the content is genuinely shared and the pace can be common: teaching the mole for the first time, drilling balanced-equation arithmetic, working through command terms, revising bonding before an end-of-unit test. Four MYP 4 students in the same cohort with the same gap will learn as much in a group as individually, and the discussion sometimes helps. Ask what the group will be doing, how many students are in it, and whether they are all in the same MYP year.

Group work is poor value the moment the work becomes specific to one student's own material. A criterion B plan cannot be redrafted in a group, because it is one student's plan. A criterion C titration table cannot be processed in a group, because it is one student's data. A marked script cannot be reviewed error by error in a group without exposing one student's work to the others. If a provider offers group pricing for that work, the honest interpretation is that the hour will be a generic lesson on how investigations work, which is not the thing you were buying.
bullets: Good value: first teaching of the mole, equation arithmetic, command terms, pre-test revision
Poor value: criterion task redrafts, one student's data, marked-script review
Ask the group size and whether every student is in the same MYP year

sections.heading: Premium pricing, examiner claims and what a high rate should buy
paragraphs: At the top of the Dubai market, AED 500 to AED 650 an hour is published, and it is usually justified on one of three grounds: examiner experience, a track record of high scores, or scarcity of the subject and level. Only the third is straightforwardly verifiable, and it is also the least often stated. The first two deserve direct questions before a parent pays four times the qualified band.

On examiner claims, the position we take is deliberately conservative. We do not describe tutors as IB or Cambridge examiners, because current examiner status for an individual is not something we can evidence, and because examiner status must never be used to imply access to marking schemes, grade boundaries or unreleased paper content. If a provider's price rests on that claim, ask what they will show you and what exactly it entitles your child to. A reasonable answer describes familiarity with mark schemes. An unreasonable one hints at inside knowledge.

On track records, ask for the method rather than the headline. A claim of a particular average score needs the number of students, the years covered and how students were counted to mean anything, and most published versions in this market supply none of the three. No provider, at any price, can promise a grade in a programme whose boundaries the school applies. What a high rate can legitimately buy is a genuinely scarce specialism at a genuinely scarce hour, and in MYP chemistry the honest version of that is a tutor who has marked criterion C work in this subject at this year group. That is a question with a checkable answer.
bullets: Scarcity is the only one of the three premium justifications that is easily verified

sections.heading: The last AED 1,000 before a chemistry assessment: where it actually returns
paragraphs: Budgets often run out in the final weeks, which is exactly when the temptation to buy a large block is strongest. At the published qualified band, AED 1,000 buys between three and six hours. Spent well, that is enough to move specific marks. Spent as general revision it buys company for an evening, and the student would have revised anyway.

The first hour should be diagnostic, working through a past chemistry paper or the last marked task while the tutor counts error types rather than correcting each one. The second and third should address whichever quantitative error dominates, almost always mole conversion or titre averaging, because those recur across every paper. If criterion C work is part of the assessment, one hour on processing and the conclusion structure is worth more than three hours of content revision. Keep the final hour for a timed paper reviewed immediately afterwards.

What not to buy with the last AED 1,000: new content in the final fortnight, which competes with consolidation and usually loses; a two-hour in-home visit, where a substantial share of the fee is travel; or a group revision class covering topics the student already has. And if the assessment is an on-screen MYP 5 sitting, insist that the timed practice happens on screen rather than on paper, because the interface costs marks that content revision cannot recover. Confirm the format with the MYP coordinator first; we publish no IB dates on these pages, since the IB's own site cannot be verified automatically.

We read it before the first session so the hour opens on the actual error pattern. It also lets you judge, cheaply, whether we read it at all.
